title: Desenvolvedor Front AEM Sênior
description:
Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!


A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Front-end AEM Sênior que queira atuar em projetos desafiadores, contribuindo para soluções digitais de alto impacto. Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, atenção aos detalhes e gosta de trabalhar com performance e qualidade de código, essa vaga é para você!


O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolver e manter componentes e templates no Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
  • Trabalhar com HTML, CSS (SASS, LESS) e JavaScript (ES6+) para criar interfaces modernas e responsivas.
  • Garantir boas práticas de SEO técnico, incluindo otimização de metadados, SSR, Core Web Vitals e acessibilidade (WCAG).
  • Implementar e gerenciar consentimento de cookies (LGPD, GDPR) com ferramentas como OneTrust ou Cookiebot.
  • Integrar frameworks modernos (React, Next, Angular ou Vue.js) ao AEM.
  • Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações (lazy loading, minificação de assets, caching, uso de CDNs).
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (design, PMs e backend) para entrega de soluções de ponta.
  • Apoiar práticas de CI/CD, Docker, Git e metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Assegurar boas práticas de segurança web (XSS, CSRF, Content Security Policy).


O que esperamos de você:

  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência como Desenvolvedor Front-end.
  • Experiência sólida com Adobe Experience Manager (AEM): componentes, templates, clientlibs, Sling Models, OSGi services.
  • Domínio de HTML, CSS (SASS, LESS) e JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Conhecimento em TypeScript e Webpack.
  • Experiência com GraphQL e REST APIs.
  • Prática em SEO técnico e otimização de performance.
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de cookies e consentimento (LGPD, GDPR).
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD, Docker, Git e metodologias ágeis.
  • Noções sólidas de segurança web.


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT.


Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de desenvolvimento web para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!

title: Contracting Manager
description:
Contracting Manager

Location – Brazil

Full Time


About Us

HBX Group is the world’s leading technological partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard-to-reach high-value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course, we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality.


Job Summary:

As the face of Hotelbeds to our suppliers, you will develop strong relationships with our suppliers for a defined portfolio of hotels within a specific geographic area.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the contracting process with our clients in a B2B and B2C environment, focused on signing the most competitive rates for Hotelbeds.
  • Negotiate contract renewal conditions such as: rate, inventory, offers, release periods, marketing contributions, overrides, cancellation policy.
  • Monitor the performance of each hotel working closely with the Yield Manager to ensure competitiveness and availability is not an issue.
  • Act as the face-to-face key point contact for experienced suppliers and develop and maintain excellent relationships with them.
  • Support the resolution of major supplier or client complaints, negotiating the most suitable solution to maintain good service and a positive relationship with them.
  • Ensure the supplier has a clear understanding of Hotelbeds value proposition and marketing tools to optimize the income of each contract.


Skillset and Experience Required:

  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in contracting and supplier management within the travel or hospitality industry.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and implement improvement strategies.
  • Proficiency in relevant software tools and systems.
  • Languages: Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good.

We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.


You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse ArchitectAbout the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

Client : Gaming giant

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET / Vue.js)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of software development experience to join our U.S.-based client's product development team. This individual will work on the client's Docs product, a multi-tenant document management system built with modern .NET and Vue.js technologies. This is an opportunity to work on a sophisticated platform that serves customers primarily in the oil and gas industry with a proven 2-week release cadence.


This position requires an individual who enjoys having complete ownership of features from conception to production, encompassing database schema changes, backend APIs, and frontend interfaces, all with comprehensive test coverage. We believe in the "you build it, you own it, you ship it" philosophy. You'll work in an environment that values craftsmanship, modern development practices, and strategic use of AI coding assistants to amplify productivity.

The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across nine countries.


Core Responsibilities

  • Own Features End-to-End: Take complete ownership of features from initial design through production deployment, including database, backend ( .NET), frontend (Vue.js), testing, deployment, and post-launch monitoring
  • Architect Solutions: Design and implement scalable, maintainable solutions following our established patterns (Repository-Task-Controller, multi-tenancy, service-oriented design)
  • Maintain Quality: Write comprehensive unit and integration tests using NUnit, Moq, and FluentAssertions with 80%+ code coverage targets- own the quality of your code
  • Code Reviews: Review pull requests from team members and AI-generated code, ensuring adherence to architectural patterns and best practices
  • Collaborate on Planning: Work with the team in Azure DevOps to refine stories, estimate effort, and plan sprint deliverables have input in what you build
  • Mentor: Share knowledge with team members and help elevate the team's technical capabilities
  • Support Your Features: Own the operational health of features you build- troubleshoot issues, monitor performance, and participate in on-call rotation


Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core 8.0 with proper authentication, authorization, and error handling
  • Build responsive user interfaces with Vue.js 3, Vuetify 3, and modern JavaScript patterns
  • Design and implement database schemas and migrations using Dapper and FluentMigrator with SQL Server
  • Create and maintain integration connectors using our DVIC (Quartz.NET-based) scheduling framework
  • Implement message-based communication using MassTransit and RabbitMQ
  • Work with Azure cloud services (Blob Storage, App Service, Web PubSub, Azure DevOps)
  • Participate in the migration of legacy AngularJS applications to Vue.js 3
  • Leverage AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, etc.) to accelerate development while maintaining quality standards


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills; able to document technical
  • decisions and collaborate effectively
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with demonstrable full-stack expertise
  • Strong C# and .NET proficiency: Experience with ASP.NET Core, dependency injection, async/await patterns
  • Modern JavaScript/TypeScript: Solid understanding of ES6+, async programming, and modern frontend frameworks
  • Frontend Framework Experience: Production experience with Vue.js, React, or Angular (Vue.js preferred)
  • SQL Database Expertise: Strong SQL skills, experience with database design, query optimization, and writing efficient SQL queries
  • Docker: Hands-on experience with Docker for containerization, local development environments, and understanding container orchestration
  • API Design: Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs with proper authentication, versioning, and documentation
  • Testing Mindset: Track record of writing unit tests, integration tests, and maintaining high code coverage
  • Version Control: Proficient with Git workflows, pull requests, code reviews, and branching strategies
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical and debugging skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the stack
  • Ownership Mentality: Track record of seeing features through from conception to production, including post-deployment support and iteration


Desired Experience

  • University degree or equivalent educational experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience with Vue.js 3 (Composition API or Options API) and Vuetify
  • Experience with micro-ORMs like Dapper or similar lightweight data access libraries
  • Familiarity with database migration tools (FluentMigrator, DbUp, or similar)
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant architecture patterns and considerations
  • Experience with Azure cloud services (App Service, Blob Storage, Azure DevOps)
  • Knowledge of message bus patterns (MassTransit, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus)
  • Experience with service-oriented architecture and inter-service communication patterns
  • Background in document management, workflow systems, or enterprise SaaS platforms
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Familiarity with Auth0 or similar identity management platforms
  • Experience working with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) in a production environment


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively and efficiently. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Project Manager
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Role Overview

The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering projects within scope, time, and budget constraints. This role focuses on managing cross-functional teams, ensuring stakeholder alignment, and driving operational excellence across diverse business initiatives. Unlike senior Program Managers, this position emphasizes hands-on project execution rather than portfolio-level strategy.

  • Monitor progress and adjust schedules as needed to meet deadlines.
  • Ensure adherence to organizational project management methodologies.
  • Stakeholder Communication

  • Prepare and present status reports to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Risk & Issue Management
  • Identify potential risks early and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Escalate critical issues promptly to leadership.
  • Budget & Resource Management
  • Track project budgets and ensure cost-effective delivery.
  • Coordinate with resource managers for staffing needs.
  • Quality Assurance
  • Maintain compliance with internal standards and client expectations.
  • Conduct post-project reviews and implement lessons learned.


✅ Required Qualifications

  • PMP certification preferred (or equivalent like PRINCE2).
  • Project management experience in IT or business domains.
  • Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile).
  • Proficiency in tools like MS Project, JIRA, Confluence.

title: Desenvolvedor de front-end - Shopify
description:
Buscamos um desenvolvedor Shopify. A posição é remota e o fuso horário deve estar alinhado com o de Pittsburgh (EUA) .


Responsabilidades:

1. Reescrita do Storefront em Hydrogen

  • Reconstruir e aprimorar a vitrine Shopify existente da Industrial Powder usando Hydrogen 2.0 e a Shopify Storefront GraphQL API .
  • Replicar e melhorar o conjunto de recursos atual:
  • Páginas de detalhes de produtos
  • Diferenciação entre produtos sob encomenda, em estoque, painéis, tambores e pequenos lotes
  • Coleções com filtragem
  • Lógica de preços específica para B2B
  • Descontos, comportamento do carrinho e integração de checkout
  • Gerenciamento de contas de clientes
  • Pesquisa, navegação e acessibilidade
  • Layout responsivo com foco em dispositivos móveis


2. Biblioteca de Componentes Reutilizáveis

  • Criar uma biblioteca de componentes de interface (UI) baseada em React , seguindo o sistema de design PPG Primer :
  • Reconstruir componentes principais (botões, cabeçalhos, banners, modais, tabelas etc.) para React, usando os tokens de design existentes (atualmente uma biblioteca de componentes em .NET)
  • Garantir acessibilidade, responsividade e personalização
  • Fornecer documentação e exemplos ao vivo usando o Storybook
  • Entregar como um submódulo Git ou pacote privado NPM


3. Framework de Configuração de Lançamento Rápido

  • Entregar um modelo inicial (Starter Template) em Hydrogen para futuras vitrines:
  • Modelos de configuração de ambiente
  • Suporte para substituição de temas conforme a marca de cada região
  • Roteamento, localização e configuração de CI/CD pré-configurados
  • Estrutura de pastas escalável e alternância entre regiões


4. Integração com o CMS Kontent.ai

  • Integrar o Kontent.ai como CMS para todo o conteúdo não relacionado a produtos:
  • Utilizar as APIs GraphQL ou REST do Kontent.ai para entregar conteúdo aos componentes Hydrogen
  • Implementar blocos de conteúdo modulares gerenciados pelo CMS (Hero, Banner Promocional, Depoimentos, FAQs etc.)
  • Habilitar layouts de página dinâmicos e páginas de marketing (ex.: /sobre-nos, /sustentabilidade)
  • Integração no nível de rotas: permitir que o CMS controle navegação e estrutura de layout
  • Suporte a campos de conteúdo localizados para vitrines multilíngues e multi-regiões
  • Implementar funcionalidade de pré-visualização segura para revisar atualizações de conteúdo em ambiente de testes
  • Colaborar com os responsáveis pelo conteúdo para definir e implementar modelos e fluxos de trabalho dentro do Kontent.ai

title: Gerente de planejamento comercial
description:
Vaga: Gerente de Planejamento Comercial

Localização: Rio de Janeiro, RJ


Estruturar e gerenciar o planejamento estratégico das coleções, liderando a equipe de especialistas, analistas e assistentes de planejamento com foco no ciclo de vida do produto e na otimização do merchandising.

O profissional será responsável por garantir a assertividade do mix de produtos, gerenciar o orçamento de compras (OTB) e otimizar os níveis de estoque, visando maximizar as vendas, o giro e a rentabilidade do negócio, enquanto desenvolve e orienta seu time.


Principais Responsabilidades


1. Planejamento de Produto e Coleção (Pré-Temporada):

  • Análise de Performance: Supervisionar a análise de dados históricos de vendas (curva de produtos, categorias, atributos) para identificar tendências, oportunidades e riscos.
  • Construção do OTB (Open-to-Buy): Desenvolver e gerenciar o orçamento de compras (OTB) por coleção e categoria, alinhado às metas financeiras da companhia.
  • Definição do Sortimento (Mix): Liderar as discussões com as áreas de Estilo e Compras para definir a arquitetura da coleção (pirâmide de produtos, mix, amplitude vs. profundidade).
  • Planejamento de Demanda: Garantir a acuracidade do forecast de vendas e da projeção de necessidades de compra (compra inicial vs. reposição).

2. Planejamento de Merchandising (Durante a Temporada):

  • Gestão de Estoque: Monitorar e direcionar o time na análise da performance do estoque (cobertura, giro, sell-through) e no gerenciamento do fluxo de produtos.
  • Alocação e Abastecimento: Definir e supervisionar a estratégia de distribuição inicial (alocação) e o plano de reposição (abastecimento) para as lojas e canais.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida: Orientar a equipe na identificação de produtos (Best Sellers, Slow Movers) e liderar a proposição de ações comerciais (promoções, remarcações) para otimizar o ciclo de vida.
  • Planejamento de Liquidação: Estruturar a estratégia de markdown (remarcação) ao final da coleção, visando a limpeza do estoque com o mínimo impacto na margem.

3. Gestão de Equipe e Performance:

  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento: Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe de analistas e planejadores, orientando as entregas diárias e promovendo o crescimento profissional do time.
  • Gestão de Desempenho: Definir metas e KPIs para a equipe, acompanhando a performance individual e coletiva através de feedbacks e planos de desenvolvimento.
  • Controle de Qualidade: Assegurar a precisão, a qualidade e o cumprimento de prazos de todas as entregas, relatórios e análises da área.
  • Consolidação de KPIs: Ser o guardião dos indicadores de planejamento (Giro, Cobertura, Sell-Through, Margem, GMROI), consolidando os resultados e criando planos de ação.
  • Interface Estratégica: Liderar a interface e atuar como o principal ponto de contato entre as áreas de Compras, Estilo, Logística e Vendas, garantindo o alinhamento do planejamento.


Requisitos Essenciais


  • Experiência: Sólida experiência prévia em Planejamento Comercial, Produto ou Merchandising, adquirida obrigatoriamente no Varejo de Moda.
  • Gestão de Pessoas: Comprovada experiência em gestão de equipes (supervisão, coordenação ou gerência), mesmo que de times pequenos.
  • Competências Técnicas:
  • Domínio avançado em Excel (modelagem, tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas complexas).
  • Profundo conhecimento em gestão de OTB (Open-to-Buy).
  • Ampla vivência com os principais indicadores de varejo (KPIs) e do ciclo de vida do produto.
  • Perfil:
  • Capacidade de liderar, inspirar e desenvolver pessoas.
  • Perfil altamente analítico, estruturado e com forte raciocínio lógico.
  • Habilidade de transformar dados complexos em insights acionáveis.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociar e influenciar áreas parceiras.
  • Formação: Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Moda (com foco em Negócios) ou áreas correlatas.


Diferenciais (Desejável)


  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Varejo, Finanças ou Negócios ou afins.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experiência com planejamento em múltiplos canais (Omnichannel - Lojas Físicas e E-commerce).

  • Levantar dados de campo junto às unidades de negócio (bombas, motores, pressões, vazões, faturas e medições elétricas) e construir baseline energético.

  • Executar planos de medição e verificação (IPMVP A/B/C/D), manter repositório de evidências e emitir relatórios de economia de energia.
  • Construir dashboards e análises (Excel/Power BI) para acompanhamento de KPIs e rotinas de melhoria contínua.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em eficiência energética/gestão de energia.
  • Domínio de sistemas de bombeamento e acionamentos (VFD/soft-starter), leitura de diagramas elétricos e grandezas de qualidade de energia.
  • Vivência com medidores/analisadores, tarifação e análise de faturas.
  • Conhecimento em M&V (IPMVP) e estatística básica (normalização por clima/produção).
  • Proficiência em Excel.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens recorrentes às unidades de negócio.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Certificações CMVP, CEM e/ou ISO 50001.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI.
  • Experiência prática em campo com medições e comissionamento energético.


Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +800 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

Location: Remote - Brazil

Industry: IT & Services, Data & Analytics.


Business Systems Analyst | About You

As a Business Systems Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the success of a Pay-Per-Use program by identifying, triaging, and resolving data and process discrepancies tied to financial operations. You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. You’re comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don’t interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes. You are detail-oriented, naturally curious, and confident working independently to drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.


Business Systems Analyst | Day-to-Day

  • Triage and resolve data issues within the Pay-Per-Use program by identifying root causes and directing them to the appropriate teams.
  • Maintain and manage the team’s Jira board, including issue tracking, documentation, and validation of outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot and update Tableau reports (10–15 dashboards), ensuring accuracy and relevance of the displayed data.
  • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.
  • Contribute to chatbot proof-of-concept development by providing data insights and supporting testing activities.


Business Systems Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Proficient in writing SQL queries for data investigation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience modifying and troubleshooting Tableau dashboards and working with backend data sources.
  • Skilled in managing issues in Jira and working across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with navigating Salesforce and SAP for data verification (no development or admin experience required).

title: Instrutor de Treinamento Concur – Módulo Expense
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?



O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


Principal responsabilidade: Conduzir treinamentos técnicos, de forma pontual voltados a key users, com foco em revisar, ajustar e otimizar as configurações do Concur (Módulo Expense). O objetivo é aprimorar o uso da ferramenta na operação atual do cliente, garantindo autonomia e capacitação dos usuários-chave.


Atividades:

  • Ministrar treinamentos práticos e personalizados conforme o ambiente do cliente;
  • Orientar os key users na execução e validação de configurações do módulo Expense;
  • Apoiar na revisão e otimização de workflows de aprovação e processos internos;
  • Coordenar testes de mesa com cenários reais para validação das customizações;
  • Elaborar recomendações de melhoria e plano de ajustes pós-treinamento;
  • Emitir relatórios técnicos com registro das decisões e oportunidades de aprimoramento.


Requisitos:

  • Ter vivência com concur com implantação e regras de negócio para o expense



Utilizando Métodos:

  • Treinamento técnico voltado a key users;
  • Customizações práticas no ambiente do cliente;
  • Execução de testes de mesa com cenários reais;
  • Recomendações e plano de melhoria pós-treinamento.
  • Configurações e ajustes de parâmetros;
  • Revisão e otimização de workflows de aprovação;
  • Alterações de rotas e validações;
  • Emissão e análise de relatórios de gestão e operacionais;
  • Testes de validação com key users;
  • Elaboração de plano de melhorias e ajustes estruturais.
  • 16h – Treinamento e configurações;
  • 8h – Testes de mesa com key users e simulações reais;
  • 8h – Refinamentos e ajustes de workflows;
  • 4h – Elaboração de relatório técnico e recomendações;
  • 4h – Sessão de revisão e acompanhamento pós-treinamento.
  • Ajustes aplicados no ambiente;
  • Registro técnico das decisões de configuração;
  • Relatório de oportunidades e próximos passos.


Onde vc vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Technical Writer

Overview: Algoseek is seeking a Technical Writer – Financial Documentation to create clear, structured, and comprehensive documentation for our datasets and APIs. This role requires both technical precision and financial knowledge, turning complex data and APIs into content that is accurate, accessible, and client-friendly. You will work closely with developers, data engineers, and product teams to ensure consistency, clarity, and usability across all documentation.


Role Details:

  • Location: 100% Remote (Global Team)
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Compensation: Competitive, with additional growth opportunities


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain clear, accurate, and structured documentation for financial APIs, datasets, and schemas.
  • Create detailed descriptions of datasets, fields, parameters, and references with consistent terminology.
  • Explain complex financial concepts (market data, instruments, indicators) in simple, client-friendly language .
  • Provide usage examples (sample queries, API calls, JSON responses) for APIs and datasets.
  • Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and product managers to gather technical details.
  • Define and enforce documentation standards, style guides, and consistency across products.
  • Continuously improve documentation based on feedback from clients and internal teams.


Essential Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Technical Writer, Data Documentation Specialist, or related role .
  • Strong understanding of APIs, datasets, data models, and JSON structures .
  • Background in finance or trading , with knowledge of instruments, market data, or financial reporting.
  • Excellent written English with the ability to simplify complex technical and financial concepts.
  • Ability to structure and organize large sets of documentation logically and consistently .
  • Skilled at collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, data, QA).


Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience with API documentation tools (e.g., OpenAPI).
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools and metadata management.
  • Basic knowledge of Python .
  • Understanding of developer experience and user-centered documentation design.
  • Prior work in fintech, data providers, or market intelligence platforms .
  • Ability to create visual aids (ER diagrams, data flow charts, architecture overviews).


Work Hours:

  • Flexible remote setup with required availability for critical U.S. market overlap hours . (fixed EST hours – 9 to 1PM)
  • Occasional late-evening coverage for key delivery periods.


What Success Looks Like

  • Clear, structured documentation that makes complex datasets and APIs accessible .
  • Consistent terminology and standards across all technical content .
  • Documentation that improves client adoption and reduces support overhead.
  • Positive feedback from internal teams and external clients on clarity and usability.


Why Join Algoseek?

  • Work with a leading provider of high-quality market data and trading solutions.
  • Collaborate with world-class engineers, researchers, and financial experts.
  • Drive innovation in automated trading systems and distributed market data solutions.
  • Be part of a remote-first, globally distributed team with a culture of ownership and excellence.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive monthly compensation aligned with experience and responsibilities.
  • A 100% remote work setup with flexibility for work-life balance.
  • An opportunity to contribute to the growth of an innovative, fast-paced market data company.
  • Professional development opportunities to help you grow into higher leadership roles.
  • If you’re a skilled finance professional ready to take the next step in your career, we’d love to hear from you! Please send your resume and a brief overview of your background and availability.

title: Desenvolvedor Sr de Integrações SAP CPI (PJ | Remoto)
description:
Modalidade: PJ

Atuação: 100% remota


Descrição:

Profissional especializado no desenvolvimento de soluções de integração, combinando APIs síncronas e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos para conectar sistemas de maneira eficiente, segura e escalável. Possui sólida experiência em SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) e Kafka , garantindo integrações robustas entre ERP SAP S/4 e sistemas distribuídos.


Atua no design e implementação de APIs REST, SOAP e OData , bem como em event streaming e pub/sub , permitindo comunicação em tempo real entre aplicações. Trabalha com práticas de DevOps, observabilidade e segurança , visando otimizar performance, resiliência e governança das integrações.


Principais habilidades:

• Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e integração de sistemas corporativos .

• Expertise em integrações síncronas via SAP CPI e integrações assíncronas via Kafka .

• Experiência em arquitetura orientada a eventos e padrões pub/sub para sistemas distribuídos escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em padrões de design de APIs (REST, SOAP, OData, OpenAPI) e event-driven architecture .


Habilidades Técnicas

• SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI): IFlows, Adapter Framework, Content Modifier, Groovy Scripts, Message Mapping, Integration Suite.

• APIs: REST, SOAP, OData, OpenAPI/Swagger.

• Segurança: OAuth 2.0, SAML, JWT.

• Event Streaming: Confluent Cloud (Kafka), Kafka Streams, KSQL, Kafka Connect, Apache Flink.

• Orquestração e Deploy: Docker, Kubernetes, Kyma, AWS EKS.

• CI/CD: Git, CTMS e CALM.

• Monitoramento: OpenTelemetry.

• Testes de Integração: Postman, SoapUI, Mountebank, Pact.

As a Clinical Research Associate at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in designing and analyzing clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contributing to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.
What You Will Be Doing
  • Completes onsite and remote monitoring activities in accordance with all ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, SOPs and study processes. Activities include qualifying potential investigative sites, initiating clinical trials, maintaining study files, providing instructions to site personnel and study close out.
  • Verifies the protection of study participants by confirming informed consent procedures and protocol have been performed in accordance to applicable regulations.
  • Ensures the integrity of clinical data and that the study is conducted in compliance with approved protocol, GCP, applicable regulations and SOPs.
  • Manages the investigative site staff to facilitate trial deliverables, e.g., subject enrollment, data deliverables.
  • Verifies proper management and accountability of Investigational Product (IP).
  • Writes and submits reports of investigational site findings and updates applicable tracking systems. Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.
  • Manages essential documents as required by local regulations and ICH-GCP guidelines before, during and after a clinical study; assists with resolution of investigational site/data queries.
  • Performs key risk assessment and management responsibilities throughout the project, including key risk indicator and site health analysis, site process evaluation, and project escalation.
  • Participates in audit preparation and follow-up activities as needed.
  • Independently performs a variety of onsite and offsite monitoring visit types.
  • Gathers and reviews information for assigned siteand identifies inconsistencies. With limitedguidance from project and functional management, assesses risk and escalatesas appropriate.
  • Assists with non-complex adhoc, short-term assignmentin support of additional studies or departmental initiatives.
  • May serve as preceptor, providing training to less experienced clinical team members.
  • Undergraduate degree or international equivalent in clinical, science, or healthrelated field from an accredited institution; health care professional licensure, i.e., registered nurse
  • Previous experience supporting clinical trials including solid on-site monitoring experience in CROs or pharma companies.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Bilingual Account Executive (Hunter/Closer)
description:
SaaS Sales for DatBot.ai & Flipbooker.com • Selling to the U.S. market • PJ contractor


Why this role: Short cycles, clear ICP, good conversion, and uncapped commission on cash collected with higher rates for self-sourced deals.


About us


We’re a lean U.S. SaaS company with products used by modern marketing teams. Engineering is in Brazil; sales targets the U.S. We value clear writing, fast experiments, and cash-in over vanity metrics.


Products


DatBot.ai – AI workflows for agencies/SMBs to research, brief, and ship content faster.


Flipbooker.com – Turns PDFs into branded, gated microsites with analytics and access control.


The role


Full-cycle AE (hunter). You’ll prospect, run tight discovery, do short narrative demos, and close straightforward Team+ deals. Self-serve stays on the websites; you own outbound and expansions.


ICP (who you’ll sell)


U.S. SMB/mid-market: Heads/VPs of Marketing, Demand Gen, Product Marketing, eComm Managers, RevOps in non-regulated industries. Natural cross-sell between products.


What you’ll do


Self-source 60–80% of pipeline via email/phone/LinkedIn + short Looms; re-engage warm leads fast.


Run discovery (why change / impact / timeline ≤90 days), do a 5–8 min demo, propose paid pilots, and close Team+ plans.


Build segmented lead lists and sequences; log clean notes; share weekly insights; surface cross-sell opportunities.


Drive a close plan on every late-stage opp (dates, owners, legal/security steps).


How we measure success (outcomes, not busywork)


Ramp:


Month 1 → 4–8 Qualified Meetings; 2–3 SAOs; 1 early win ideal.


Month 2 → 12–18 QMH; 6–8 SAOs; 1–3 wins.


Steady state (M3+): 12–20 QMH / 6–10 SAOs / 2–4 wins per month.


Cash-in: US$8k–$15k+/mo once ramped (grows as we dial in).


Quality gates we care about: Show ≥70% • Show→SAO 45–60% • SAO→Win 20–35%.


You’ll be great here if you have:


Excellent English (spoken/written) for U.S. prospect calls.


2+ years SaaS BDR/AE (U.S. SMB/mid-market a plus).


Real hunter chops: list building, smart personalization, tight copy, disciplined follow-up.


Tools: HubSpot, Apollo or similar, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Loom, Calendly, Google Workspace.


Compensation (uncapped, paid on cash collected)


Base (PJ): US$1.2k–1.8k/mo + 25–40% on cash collected for self-sourced Team+ (≥US$2k ARR), 10–20% on assisted, with accelerators. Biweekly payouts.

(Attribution and tiers shared after the intro call; standard clawbacks for early churn.)


Schedule: Remote in Brazil with ~3–4 hours overlap to U.S. ET/PT.

Engagement: PJ contractor.


Interview process


Intro screen: product pitch + quick funnel/OTE math.


Skills gauntlet: cold-call opener, discovery + 5–8 min narrative demo, objection/negotiation.


Deal deep-dive with optional paid micro-trial if mutually useful.


How to apply


Send your CV, your proudest prospecting/closing win (3–5 sentences with metrics), and:


A 90-second Loom pitching Flipbooker to a U.S. VP Marketing.


Two first-touch emails (one for DatBot.ai, one for Flipbooker) aimed at different ICPs.

description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.

Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento ágil, garantindo a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade, escaláveis e alinhadas às metas de negócio.

- Promover o uso racional de recursos em nuvem, garantindo eficiência operacional, segurança e sustentabilidade financeira.

- Atuar na mitigação de riscos técnicos e na resolução de incidentes críticos, com foco em análise de causa raiz e prevenção.



Requisitos e qualificações:

- Experiência comprovada em Engenharia de Software, Arquitetura de Sistemas e Liderança Técnica de equipes ágeis de alta performance.

- Domínio técnico em:

- Arquitetura de microserviços e integração de sistemas distribuídos

- Cloud Computing (preferencialmente AWS, Azure ou GCP)

- Banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais

- Mensageria e streaming de dados (ex: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ)

- APIs RESTful, GraphQL e boas práticas de versionamento

- Ferramentas de CI/CD, containers (Docker, Kubernetes) e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)

- Forte conhecimento em metodologias Agile/Scrum/Kanban, gestão de backlog e métricas de produtividade técnica (lead time, throughput, qualidade de código).

- Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

- Certificações desejáveis: Scrum Master, AWS Solutions Architect, DevOps, Cloud Practitioner ou similares.

- Excelentes habilidades de liderança, comunicação assertiva, gestão de conflitos, visão sistêmica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

- Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de atuar estrategicamente e operacionalmente quando necessário.

- Proatividade, curiosidade tecnológica e capacidade de inspirar e engajar pessoas em torno de objetivos comuns.



O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.

Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.

Experience with Data Architecture

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.

title: Gerente de planejamento comercial
description:
Vaga: Gerente de Planejamento Comercial

Localização: Rio de Janeiro, RJ


Estruturar e gerenciar o planejamento estratégico das coleções, liderando a equipe de especialistas, analistas e assistentes de planejamento com foco no ciclo de vida do produto e na otimização do merchandising.

O profissional será responsável por garantir a assertividade do mix de produtos, gerenciar o orçamento de compras (OTB) e otimizar os níveis de estoque, visando maximizar as vendas, o giro e a rentabilidade do negócio, enquanto desenvolve e orienta seu time.


Principais Responsabilidades


1. Planejamento de Produto e Coleção (Pré-Temporada):

  • Análise de Performance: Supervisionar a análise de dados históricos de vendas (curva de produtos, categorias, atributos) para identificar tendências, oportunidades e riscos.
  • Construção do OTB (Open-to-Buy): Desenvolver e gerenciar o orçamento de compras (OTB) por coleção e categoria, alinhado às metas financeiras da companhia.
  • Definição do Sortimento (Mix): Liderar as discussões com as áreas de Estilo e Compras para definir a arquitetura da coleção (pirâmide de produtos, mix, amplitude vs. profundidade).
  • Planejamento de Demanda: Garantir a acuracidade do forecast de vendas e da projeção de necessidades de compra (compra inicial vs. reposição).

2. Planejamento de Merchandising (Durante a Temporada):

  • Gestão de Estoque: Monitorar e direcionar o time na análise da performance do estoque (cobertura, giro, sell-through) e no gerenciamento do fluxo de produtos.
  • Alocação e Abastecimento: Definir e supervisionar a estratégia de distribuição inicial (alocação) e o plano de reposição (abastecimento) para as lojas e canais.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida: Orientar a equipe na identificação de produtos (Best Sellers, Slow Movers) e liderar a proposição de ações comerciais (promoções, remarcações) para otimizar o ciclo de vida.
  • Planejamento de Liquidação: Estruturar a estratégia de markdown (remarcação) ao final da coleção, visando a limpeza do estoque com o mínimo impacto na margem.

3. Gestão de Equipe e Performance:

  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento: Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe de analistas e planejadores, orientando as entregas diárias e promovendo o crescimento profissional do time.
  • Gestão de Desempenho: Definir metas e KPIs para a equipe, acompanhando a performance individual e coletiva através de feedbacks e planos de desenvolvimento.
  • Controle de Qualidade: Assegurar a precisão, a qualidade e o cumprimento de prazos de todas as entregas, relatórios e análises da área.
  • Consolidação de KPIs: Ser o guardião dos indicadores de planejamento (Giro, Cobertura, Sell-Through, Margem, GMROI), consolidando os resultados e criando planos de ação.
  • Interface Estratégica: Liderar a interface e atuar como o principal ponto de contato entre as áreas de Compras, Estilo, Logística e Vendas, garantindo o alinhamento do planejamento.


Requisitos Essenciais


  • Experiência: Sólida experiência prévia em Planejamento Comercial, Produto ou Merchandising, adquirida obrigatoriamente no Varejo de Moda.
  • Gestão de Pessoas: Comprovada experiência em gestão de equipes (supervisão, coordenação ou gerência), mesmo que de times pequenos.
  • Competências Técnicas:
  • Domínio avançado em Excel (modelagem, tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas complexas).
  • Profundo conhecimento em gestão de OTB (Open-to-Buy).
  • Ampla vivência com os principais indicadores de varejo (KPIs) e do ciclo de vida do produto.
  • Perfil:
  • Capacidade de liderar, inspirar e desenvolver pessoas.
  • Perfil altamente analítico, estruturado e com forte raciocínio lógico.
  • Habilidade de transformar dados complexos em insights acionáveis.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociar e influenciar áreas parceiras.
  • Formação: Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Moda (com foco em Negócios) ou áreas correlatas.


Diferenciais (Desejável)


  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Varejo, Finanças ou Negócios ou afins.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experiência com planejamento em múltiplos canais (Omnichannel - Lojas Físicas e E-commerce).

Location: Brazil

Client: Fiserv

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with Tandem/HP NonStop systems , Base24 modules, issuer/acquirer interfaces, and ATM/POS transaction processing flows.

This role requires strong technical depth in transaction message processing (ISO 8583) , ATM/POS terminal driving , and tuning systems for high availability and performance. The developer will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Application Support, Network Security, and Environment Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, enhance, and support Base24 / Base24 Classic applications on HP NonStop (Tandem) platform .
  • Maintain and modify ATM/POS transaction switch modules , authorization, settlement, and device handler components.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot end-to-end transaction flows including issuer/acquirer interfaces.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident/problem resolution .
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa/Mastercard).
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic .
  • Strong technical expertise in:
  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)
  • Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL/Enscribe
  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa/Mastercard authorization and clearing , card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.
  • Experience in incident management, change control, and release management .

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Base24-eps migration or development.
  • Experience working with Fiserv, First Data, TSYS, ACI Postilion, or Opus environments.
  • Knowledge of EMV, HSM (Thales / SafeNet) , cryptographic key management.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git , and CI/CD toolchains.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.

  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team!


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in.   • Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work

  • Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
  • Professional level of English (written and spoken)
  • Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful—you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
  • You’re a people person and love finding ways to solve problems with creative ideas
  • Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
  • You love talking through ideas, offering feedback, and helping teams align with client goals
  • A background in marketing is essential
  • Nerdiness is a bonus! If you love D&D, Pokémon, video games, or books, we’ll get along just fine!


Purpose of the Role


The Marketing Coordinator role combines project coordination with client relationship management, acting as a bridge between internal teams and clients. This role supports smooth project execution by managing internal communication, task coordination, and ensuring that all client deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest standard. You'll be integral in managing both the marketing efforts and client interactions, translating client goals into actionable tasks, and ensuring the process runs seamlessly from start to finish.


Main Objectives


1-Client Collaboration & Project Oversight:

  • Collaborate with clients to understand their marketing goals and expectations.
  • Translate these goals into clear tasks for the Marketing Coordinator, ensuring smooth project execution.
  • Regularly meet with clients to review deliverables, adjust timelines, and maintain strong relationships.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing updates, addressing concerns, and ensuring satisfaction.

  • Work closely with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other team members to develop high-quality marketing materials across all service offerings.

3-Communication & Task Management:

  • Use tools like Jiminny to document meetings, share important notes, and ensure all action items are tracked.
  • Keep all teams aligned through regular check-ins and updates, making sure deadlines are met and no tasks fall through the cracks.


4-Resource Planning & Problem Solving:

  • Manage multiple projects at once, ensuring each one is progressing smoothly, with no delays or miscommunication.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, whether they relate to resources, deadlines, or client feedback.
  • Proactively anticipate problems and find creative solutions to keep projects on track.


5-Strategic & Process-Oriented Thinking:

  • Help shape the big-picture marketing strategy with the Senior Account Manager.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve internal workflows, ensuring efficiency and consistent delivery.
  • Build strong, positive relationships both within the team and with clients, helping to drive long-term success.


Additional Skills

  • Verbal & Written Communication: Excellent communication skills—both internally and with clients.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Able to handle complex client personalities and stay calm under pressure.
  • Time Management: Proficient in balancing meetings, internal work, and client deliverables without missing a beat.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Judi is a U.S.-based healthcare technology company that provides pharmacy benefit management (PBM) services. Their focus is on making prescription drug pricing more transparent and affordable for employers, health plans, and patients.

Join our mission to transform our nation’s healthcare system as a Senior Full-stack Software Developer. In this role, you will assist in leading projects from design to delivery. Partner with product managers and designers to define requirements during discovery and planning. Collaborate with developers to deliver those requirements on time as new features or improvements to existing functionality.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • We have a remote-first culture.
  • You will make a tangible impact on society. Your code will directly improve healthcare experiences for millions.
  • We are a late-stage startup with stability. We have startup energy with a focus on delivery, but healthy processes with a strong financial outlook that provides a sense of security.


Position Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll combine technical leadership with hands-on coding to build scalable, high-impact healthcare technology. You will:

  • Exercise leadership over features from design to delivery.
  • Be a partner to product, design, and quality assurance team members.
  • Become a subject matter expert on your team’s products.
  • Provide technical support to cross-functional team members and stakeholders.
  • Expand Judi, our web-based enterprise health platform, using Python, AWS services, React/Typescript, and other technologies.
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum environment.


Preferred Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and collaborative spirit:

  • 7+ years of job-related experience.
  • Desire to work at a health tech company.
  • Strong Python (Flask / SQLAlchemy) and React / Typescript experience.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL database knowledge (e.g., common table expressions, windowing functions, views, stored procedures, full-text or geospatial indexing).
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests.
  • Git expertise and experience working in a mono repo.
  • Able to demonstrate agency, urgency, and ownership over delivering quality work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Previous Pharmacy Benefits Manager (PBM) experience is a plus.


What You Get:

  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team;
  • Unlimited PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule;
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences;
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work.


This position description is designed to be flexible, allowing management the opportunity to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities as needed to best meet organizational goals.

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
Working At Bitso

We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization.

To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.


Your Purpose

As a Sales Top Executive, you will be at the forefront of our growth strategy, tasked with winning commercial deals in key markets/verticals. Your role is not just about selling; it's about understanding customer pain points, leveraging our unique selling propositions (USP), and developing targeted commercial offers. Success in this role involves collaboration, strategic thinking, and meticulous pipeline management.


Reports To

Head of Sales


Who You Are

  • 10 years of experience in a sales position.
  • +4 years of experience selling remittances, cross-border payment and/or complex payments solutions.
  • Developed and executed comprehensive sales strategies for institutional and corporate clients.
  • Previous sales experience at a financial institution/large brokerage firm.
  • English fluency
  • Proven experience in business development and sales as a hunter.
  • Strong understanding of commercial strategy and pre-sales support
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Experience with CRM tools, preferably Hubspot.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams for seamless customer onboarding.


What You Will Do

  • Engage with potential customers, understand their pain points, and effectively communicate our USP (Unique Selling Proposition) to win new business.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to identify potential customers and provide structured feedback on generated leads.
  • Identify customer pain points and formulate targeted commercial offers to address their specific needs.
  • 360 sales cycle, open and close new business.
  • Document, track, and analyze the sales pipeline using the CRM tool (Hubspot) to ensure a robust and well-managed sales process.
  • Maintain, refresh, and expand the sales funnel, working closely with Sales Ops to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide regular updates to Senior Management.
  • Collaborate with various functions (e.g., KYC, Legal, Product) to facilitate a smooth customer onboarding process, ensuring a successful transition to production.
  • Work closely with the Account Manager during onboarding to ensure revenue targets are achieved, and customers have an exceptional experience.

Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we're looking for. If this role excites you but you don't match every point in the description, we still want to hear from you.


Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • Mission-Driven: We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso’s mission and resilient in facing industry challenges

Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento backend .NET Core , para atuar em projetos de arquitetura moderna, utilizando microsserviços , mensageria e entrega contínua . A pessoa será responsável por desenvolver, testar e evoluir APIs escaláveis e performáticas, aplicando boas práticas de Clean Code , DDD (Domain Driven Design) e desenvolvimento orientado a objetos .

O ambiente de trabalho adota metodologias ágeis , com forte colaboração entre times multidisciplinares, e foco em qualidade, automação e melhoria contínua .
