title: Profissional de Desenvolvimento Dynamics 365
description:
Código da vaga: 54907


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Profissional de Desenvolvimento Dynamics 365, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento, configuração e customização do módulo Customer Service no Dynamics 365 ;
  • Criação e manutenção de soluções utilizando Power Apps e Power Automate ;
  • Implementação de automações e fluxos de trabalho seguindo boas práticas;
  • Integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento de componentes personalizados dentro da plataforma Dynamics 365 ;
  • Apoio no levantamento e entendimento de requisitos técnicos e de negócio;
  • Documentação técnica das soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Colaboração com equipes técnicas e funcionais para garantir entregas de qualidade.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement , com foco no módulo Customer Service ;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Power Apps e Power Automate ;
  • Experiência com IA aplicada a projetos Dynamics 365 ;
  • Domínio de JavaScript , C# , .NET , Plugins e Custom Workflows no Dynamics 365 ;
  • Conhecimento em Web Resources , API REST , Dataverse e Azure Functions ;
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas eficientes.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações Microsoft relacionadas ao Dynamics 365 e Power Platform ;
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps e CI/CD para Dynamics 365.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Marketing Cloud Senior Developer - Salesforce
description:
Marketing Cloud Senior Developer - Salesforce


Visão Geral da Posição

O Desenvolvedor Sênior de Marketing Cloud será responsável por desenvolver soluções dentro da plataforma Salesforce Marketing Cloud para apoiar funções críticas de negócio e atender aos requisitos de projetos.

Essa função exige uma combinação sólida de proficiência técnica, pensamento criativo e atenção aos detalhes . O profissional colaborará de perto com equipes de marketing, design, dados e gestão de campanhas para entregar experiências digitais impactantes que envolvam milhões de clientes.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implantar soluções complexas de automação de marketing utilizando o Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Cloud Pages e Mobile Studio).
  • Implementar personalização e segmentação baseadas em dados , utilizando Data Extensions, consultas SQL e lógica AMPscript .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar Cloud Pages, formulários e landing pages integradas aos dados e APIs do Marketing Cloud.
  • Criar e manter jornadas e automações para campanhas gatilhadas, comportamentais e de ciclo de vida .
  • Projetar e implementar fluxos de integração de dados entre o SFMC e outros sistemas (Sales/Service Cloud, CDP ou fontes de dados externas).
  • Criar e gerenciar Data Extensions, atividades de consulta e processos de automação para garantir fluxo de dados eficiente.
  • Trabalhar com APIs (REST/SOAP) e Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) para integrações avançadas e conteúdo dinâmico.
  • Seguir padrões de codificação e melhores práticas dentro do ecossistema Marketing Cloud.
  • Atuar como especialista técnico (SME) em todos os trabalhos de desenvolvimento relacionados ao SFMC.
  • Colaborar com arquitetos e equipes de operações de marketing para impulsionar melhorias na plataforma e implementar novas funcionalidades.
  • Trabalhar com as equipes de marketing e design para transformar conceitos criativos em soluções tecnicamente viáveis.
  • Revisar códigos e orientar desenvolvedores juniores , garantindo escalabilidade, performance e manutenibilidade.
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas técnicos , otimizando para velocidade, confiabilidade e engajamento.
  • Supervisionar testes de renderização e entregabilidade utilizando ferramentas como o Litmus .
  • Manter altos padrões de privacidade de dados, conformidade (CAN-SPAM, GDPR) e segurança.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de analytics para estabelecer rastreamento de performance, relatórios e insights a partir dos dados do SFMC.
  • Avaliar continuamente novos recursos do SFMC, atualizações e melhores práticas do mercado para aprimorar as capacidades da plataforma.
  • Explorar e implementar recursos de IA, personalização e inteligência preditiva dentro do Marketing Cloud.


Habilidades e Experiência:

  • Graduação em TI, Ciência da Computação ou área equivalente , com 7 a 10 anos de experiência em TI e mínimo de 5 anos com Salesforce Marketing Cloud .
  • Conhecimento aprofundado da plataforma Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) e compreensão dos conceitos essenciais de e-mail marketing e automação .
  • Experiência com Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automations, SQL, Content Builder e criação de audiências para Advertising Studio .
  • Proficiência em HTML, CSS, JavaScript e AMPscript para desenvolvimento de e-mails.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e experiência em testes e depuração de e-mails usando o Litmus .
  • Compreensão das melhores práticas da Salesforce para automação de marketing .
  • Capacidade e vontade de trabalhar com alto grau de autonomia e senso de propriedade em uma equipe geograficamente distribuída , composta por outros desenvolvedores e recursos de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal .
  • Ingles avançado


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação : Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

title: Audio Transcription Specialist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


Job Title: Audio Transcription Specialist (Language: Portuguese, Location: Portugal)


About The Role:

We are seeking detail-oriented and dedicated professionals with hands-on experience in audio transcription and quality assurance . The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurately converting audio content into written text, maintaining high standards of accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Listen carefully to audio recordings and transcribe them into clear, accurate, and grammatically correct text .
  • Identify and correct transcription errors , ensuring proper spelling, punctuation, and formatting.
  • Handle different accents, speech clarity levels, and background noises with attention to detail.
  • Tag and label transcriptions as per project guidelines.
  • Review, proofread, and edit transcripts for quality, accuracy, and completeness .
  • Follow client-specific formatting and delivery instructions.
  • Work closely with project leads and QA teams to meet daily quality and productivity targets .
  • Maintain confidentiality and data security of all content handled.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in audio transcription or related linguistic work.
  • Excellent command of English (or other project-specific language) with strong grammar and listening skills.
  • Good typing speed and accuracy with familiarity in transcription tools or software.
  • Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines .
  • High attention to detail and ability to follow formatting guidelines strictly.
  • Must have a reliable internet connection, functional laptop/desktop, and good-quality headphones (mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in AI training, transcription QA, or linguistic data projects .
  • Familiarity with timestamping, labeling, or annotation tasks .
  • Experience working with global transcription platforms or large-scale linguistic projects.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text software and audio editing tools is an added advantage.

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
Title: Staff Platform Engineer

Business Unit: Process Manufacturing

Location: Brazil, remote

About CAI

CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform

  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies

  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment

  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations
  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations
  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems
  • CRM and Systems Administration
  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards
  • Data and Reporting
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

description:
Title: Staff Platform Engineer

Business Unit: Process Manufacturing

Location: Brazil, remote

About CAI

CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform
  • Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and other stakeholders to develop new cloud-platform features and products
  • Create technical documentation for accessing, integrating, and using Parsable platform capabilities
  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies
  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization
  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment
  • 5+ years experience developing backend services capabilities leveraging Go and/or Node (Typescript)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

title: KOL BD Manager
description:
Overview: We are seeking a motivated and experienced KOL Business Development Manager to join our dynamic team at Bitunix. In this role, you will be responsible for building and nurturing relationships with KOLs within the cryptocurrency community to drive trading

volume and enhance brand visibility.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify, recruit, and onboard influential KOLs, traders, and community leaders to promote our exchange platform.
  • Develop and execute strategies to increase trading volume through KOL partnerships and promotional activities.
  • Collaborate with marketing and content teams to create compelling campaigns and content tailored for KOL audiences.
  • Organize and host webinars, AMAs (Ask Me Anything sessions), and other events with KOLs to educate and engage the community.
  • Monitor and analyze the impact of KOL activities on trading volume and user acquisition, providing regular reports and insights to management.
  • Stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and regulatory developments to adapt KOL strategies accordingly.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, including product, compliance, and support teams, to ensure alignment on KOL initiatives.
  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and meetups to network with potential KOL partners and enhance brand presence.

title: Instrutor MQ Series
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Instrutor MQ Series


Estamos buscando um **Instrutor especializado em IBM MQ** para ministrar curso voltado para desenvolvedores, com foco em integração de sistemas mainframe e aplicações modernas. O profissional será responsável por capacitar equipes de desenvolvimento em tecnologias de mensageria corporativa, COBOL e boas práticas de integração.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS

Ensino e Treinamento

  • Ministrar cursos remotos sobre IBM MQ para desenvolvedores
  • Desenvolver e atualizar material didático (apresentações, exercícios práticos, documentação)
  • Criar cenários de simulação e laboratórios práticos
  • Avaliar o progresso dos alunos e fornecer feedback construtivo
  • Adaptar o conteúdo conforme o nível técnico da turma

Desenvolvimento de Conteúdo

  • Elaborar guias de melhores práticas para IBM MQ
  • Criar exemplos práticos de integração COBOL + IBM MQ
  • Desenvolver casos de uso reais para exercícios
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada
  • Produzir material de apoio (manuais, quick references, troubleshooting guides)

Suporte Técnico

  • Auxiliar desenvolvedores na resolução de problemas técnicos
  • Fornecer consultoria em arquitetura de soluções com IBM MQ
  • Apoiar na implementação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Realizar code reviews e orientações técnicas

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

Experiência Técnica

  • Mínimo 5 anos** de experiência com IBM MQ (WebSphere MQ)
  • Experiência sólida** em desenvolvimento COBOL
  • Conhecimento em **ambientes mainframe** (z/OS, CICS, DB2)
  • Experiência com **integração de sistemas** e arquiteturas SOA/ESB
  • Conhecimento em **JCL, copybooks** e estruturas de dados mainframe

Experiência em Ensino

  • Mínimo 2 anos** ministrando treinamentos técnicos
  • Experiência com **desenvolvimento de material didático**
  • Habilidade para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara

Competências Técnicas Específicas

  • Configuração e administração de Queue Managers**
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações que utilizam MQGET, MQPUT, MQOPEN, MQCLOSE**
  • Conhecimento em MQ Channels, Queues, Topics**
  • Experiência com MQ Explorer** e ferramentas de monitoramento
  • Troubleshooting de problemas de conectividade e performance
  • Conhecimento em MQ Security** (SSL/TLS, autenticação, autorização)

Soft Skills

  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Paciência e didática para ensinar
  • Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes perfis de alunos
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas
  • Trabalho em equipe e colaboração

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

Certificações

  • IBM Certified Solution Developer - WebSphere MQ



Formação Acadêmica


  • Graduação completa.

PJ

title: Bolsista Doutor - Digital Care 2 You- Aplicação de Inteligência Artificial na Jornada do paciente | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Vem transformar com a gente!

A Digital Care 2 You é uma healthtech comprometida com a transformação digital da saúde pública e suplementar por meio da inovação responsável. Atuamos com soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial, Big Data e interoperabilidade de sistemas, com foco em segurança clínica, ética, conformidade e impacto real na jornada do paciente.

Nosso propósito é claro: ampliar o acesso, a precisão e a qualidade do cuidado por meio da tecnologia, sempre respeitando os princípios éticos e os marcos legais da área da saúde.


Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Bioinformática, Inteligência Artificial Aplicada, áreas afins.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.


Projeto: Aplicação de Inteligência Artificial na Jornada do paciente.


Principais Atividades:

· Mapeamento e análise de requisitos com times multiprofissionais.

· Integração de dados.

· Desenvolvimento e validação de modelos de IA em saúde.

· Criação de ferramentas automatizadas.

· Avaliação contínua de impacto, performance e acurácia dos modelos de IA.

· Elaboração de documentação técnica e treinamentos para equipes de tecnologia e saúde.

· Garantia de segurança, anonimização, ética e conformidade com a LGPD e boas práticas de IA.


Conhecimento necessário:

· Domínio de Python, R, Java Script, SQL, React, Node ou similares e bibliotecas de IA.

· Experiência com integração de dados em saúde e padrões de interoperabilidade.

· Portfólio técnico ou publicações científicas em projetos de IA em saúde.

· Conhecimento da LGPD e princípios éticos para uso de IA.

Conhecimento desejável:

· Experiência com projetos na área de saúde.

· Participação em iniciativas nacionais ou internacionais de interoperabilidade.

· Certificações técnicas.

· Idioma: Inglês.


Valor da bolsa (mensal): Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho: Remoto

Local: Remoto

Soft Skills: Autogestão, Pensamento crítico, Criatividade, Organização.

title: Video Ad Copywriter – Paid Media & AI-Driven Creative
description:
About the Role

Property Leads is a fast-growing real estate lead generation and data company. We’re looking for a Paid Media Ad Copywriter who can craft high-performing copy across multiple digital channels. This role blends creative storytelling with performance marketing expertise , you’ll write, test, and optimize ad copy that drives engagement and lead generation.

You’ll collaborate closely with the team to develop data-driven ad messaging that scales across platforms. If you love combining words, metrics, and AI tools to create ads that convert — this role is for you.

Responsibilities Copywriting for Performance
  • Write and test compelling copy for paid ads across Meta, TikTok, Google, and YouTube .

  • Craft headlines, primary text, CTAs, scripts , and short-form hooks that align with each platform’s audience behavior.

  • Adapt messaging for various funnel stages (TOFU, MOFU, BOFU) to optimize conversions.

  • Collaborate with designers and video editors to align visuals and copy for cohesive creative execution.

    • Creative Strategy & Optimization
    • Develop multiple copy variations for A/B testing and analyze performance metrics like CTR, CPA, ROAS, and conversion rate .

    • Use data insights and feedback from the Paid Media team to refine messaging and improve outcomes.

    • Research competitors, market trends, and ad libraries to identify new creative angles.

    • Maintain an organized library of top-performing headlines, hooks, and frameworks.

    • AI & Automation
    • Leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Jasper, Copy.ai, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, or Runway to assist in scriptwriting, ideation, and ad copy generation.

    • Experiment with AI-driven testing to quickly iterate and scale winning copy.

    • Collaboration & Workflow
    • Work with the Creative, Media Buying, and Strategy teams to ensure copy aligns with campaign goals.

    • Meet deadlines for consistent delivery of new ad variations.

    • Take initiative in creative brainstorming sessions and performance reviews.

    • Expected Outcomes
    • Increased ad engagement and click-through rates (CTR).

    • Improved conversion rates and reduced cost per acquisition (CPA).

    • Faster creative testing cycles through AI and automation.

    • Consistent production of fresh, high-performing copy variants.

    • Qualifications Required
    • 3–5 years of experience writing copy for paid media (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or Google).

    • Strong understanding of performance metrics (CTR, CPA, ROAS, etc.) and how copy impacts them.

    • Proven track record in direct response, lead generation, or performance marketing .

    • Excellent command of English , with attention to detail and tone adaptation.

    • Experience using AI tools to ideate or generate ad concepts and scripts.

    • Ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

    • Preferred
    • Experience in real estate, e-commerce, or lead generation industries.

    • Familiarity with UGC-style scripting and short-form video ad copy.

    • Basic understanding of media buying and campaign structure.

    • Knowledge of AI-driven creative workflows (text-to-video, voiceovers, etc.).

    • Benefits
    • Competitive compensation

    • 100% remote work-from-anywhere environment

    • Collaborative, innovative culture that values data, creativity, and growth

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Júnior
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.


#Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


#Requisitos e qualificações:

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.



#NeoJourney l Cardápio de Benefícios:

Vale Alimentação/Refeição;

title: Full Stack Senior Engineer
description:
Company Description

With 18 years of experience in technology, DEVELL has delved into the field of Generative Artificial Intelligence since its inception, positioning itself as a significant player in a market full of endless possibilities. Our deep understanding and practical application of Generative AI make us the ideal partner for companies looking to explore and maximize the potential of this revolutionary technology. At DEVELL, we convert emerging opportunities into tangible solutions that drive innovation and growth.


Role Description

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript) to join our growing engineering team. You will work on high-impact projects, contributing to front-end and back-end solutions that demand scalability, maintainability, and architectural elegance.


This is not just about coding – we want someone who can design abstract solutions, implement complex features, and influence technical decisions that shape our platform for years to come.


Responsibilities

  • ⁠Architect, design, and implement scalable full-stack applications using TypeScript.
  • Build and maintain back-end services with NestJS.
  • Contribute to front-end development using at least two frameworks among Angular, React, Svelte, or Vue.
  • ⁠Design modular and abstract solutions that reduce complexity and improve maintainability across projects.
  • ⁠Collaborate with cross-functional teams (AI, product, design, and infrastructure) to deliver robust solutions.
  • Review code, mentor peers, and promote best practices in software engineering.
  • Take ownership of complex features from concept to production.


Qualifications

  • ⁠Mandatory: Strong proficiency in TypeScript.
  • Mandatory: Proven experience with NestJS.
  • Mandatory: Experience in at least two front-end frameworks among Angular, React, Svelte, Vue.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture patterns (DI, modularization, micro frontends, event-driven, etc.).
  • Experience building and maintaining complex, scalable systems.
  • Strong grasp of CSS, HTML5, responsive design, and UI performance optimization.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to collaborate in remote-first teams.
  • A mindset for clean code, testing, and maintainability.


Nice to Have

  • ⁠Experience with microservices or event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • ⁠Knowledge of design systems and component-driven development.
  • Experience with AI-powered applications.
  • Experience managing internal packages using private registries (npm, Verdaccio, GitLab, etc.).
  • ⁠Hands-on experience with bundlers (Webpack, Vite, esbuild, Nx).

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Contract

Location: Remote - Brazil

Industry: IT & Services, Data & Analytics.


Business Systems Analyst | About You

As a Business Systems Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the success of a Pay-Per-Use program by identifying, triaging, and resolving data and process discrepancies tied to financial operations. You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. You’re comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don’t interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes. You are detail-oriented, naturally curious, and confident working independently to drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.


Business Systems Analyst | Day-to-Day

  • Triage and resolve data issues within the Pay-Per-Use program by identifying root causes and directing them to the appropriate teams.
  • Maintain and manage the team’s Jira board, including issue tracking, documentation, and validation of outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot and update Tableau reports (10–15 dashboards), ensuring accuracy and relevance of the displayed data.
  • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.
  • Contribute to chatbot proof-of-concept development by providing data insights and supporting testing activities.


Business Systems Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Proficient in writing SQL queries for data investigation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience modifying and troubleshooting Tableau dashboards and working with backend data sources.
  • Skilled in managing issues in Jira and working across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with navigating Salesforce and SAP for data verification (no development or admin experience required).

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Negócios
description:
A GP Strategies Corporation é um dos principais fornecedores mundiais de transformação de talentos. Ao oferecer soluções premiadas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento, ajudamos as organizações a se transformarem por meio de seu pessoal e a alcançarem mudanças significativas. A GP Strategies forneceu suas soluções inovadoras de consultoria, serviços de aprendizado e tecnologia de talentos para mais de 6.000 organizações em todo o mundo.


Com base em nossa experiência global de trabalho em milhares de projetos e iniciativas nos últimos 55 anos, aprendemos que relacionamentos, negócios, trabalho, inovação, estratégia e transformação têm tudo a ver com pessoas. E, em poucas palavras, a GP Strategies é o nosso pessoal: uma extensa rede global de especialistas em aprendizado. Saiba mais em


Estamos buscando um Analista de Desenvolvimento de Negócios que promova e venda os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela GP Strategies Corporation a clientes novos e existentes.


Esquema de trabalho: Remoto - com viagens.


Principais atividades:


  • Utiliza o conhecimento das competências e da estratégia de negócios da empresa para garantir novas oportunidades de negócios com clientes existentes e potenciais, de acordo com os planos e programas de marketing da empresa.
  • Identifica parcerias importantes que impulsionarão os negócios futuros.
  • Negocia acordos comerciais importantes.
  • Estabelece análises competitivas, identifica tendências e articula o impacto potencial em áreas específicas do negócio.
  • Apresenta análises de casos de negócios à gerência executiva.
  • Trabalha com os clientes atuais para identificar e atender às necessidades, resolver reclamações e verificar a satisfação do cliente.
  • Mantém contato frequente com as operações relativas às obrigações contratuais atuais e trabalha com a equipe para estabelecer ferramentas de comunicação eficazes.
  • Trabalha em conjunto com outras unidades de negócios no que se refere ao desenvolvimento de negócios e iniciativas da empresa.
  • Trabalha em estreita colaboração com outros funcionários de desenvolvimento de negócios para garantir que os principais objetivos e prazos sejam cumpridos.
  • Participa de convenções, seminários e outras atividades comerciais para promover a GP junto a clientes, clientes potenciais e fornecedores.


Requisitos:


  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência anterior em desenvolvimento de negócios, vendas B2B ou gestão de parcerias estratégicas.
  • Conhecimento de análise de mercado, tendências e cenário competitivo.
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de CRM e software de gestão comercial.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Espanhol avançado será uma vantagem.
  • Experiência anterior na área comercial de consultoria - desejável.


Outras habilidades:


  • Fortes habilidades de negociação para estabelecer acordos comerciais vantajosos.
  • Capacidade de construir parcerias estratégicas e identificar oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Mentalidade analítica para apresentar estudos de caso e análises de viabilidade à liderança.
  • Orientado para resultados, com foco em metas comerciais e satisfação do cliente.


Com mais de 4.000 funcionários em mais de 30 países, a diversidade na GP Strategies é uma segunda natureza! Além de nossas localidades, nossa cultura se concentra no desempenho e gira em torno do respeito, da justiça e do trabalho colaborativo para atingir nossos objetivos. Apoiamos nossos funcionários, não importa quem sejam ou de onde venham, porque todos nós temos perspectivas e abordagens valiosas e exclusivas. É assim que nascem as grandes ideias, que nos permitem trabalhar de forma mais inteligente.


A GP Strategies tem o compromisso e o orgulho de ser um empregador de oportunidades iguais. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para emprego sem levar em conta raça, nacionalidade, gênero, idade, religião, deficiência, orientação sexual, status de veterano ou estado civil.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior Benefits Manager LATAM
description:
The Senior Benefits Manager – Latin America will lead the strategy, design, and management of employee benefits programs across the Latin American region for a global technology company. This role ensures our benefits offerings are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with our mission to attract and retain world-class talent.

You’ll serve as a trusted regional expert—partnering closely with Global Rewards, regional and local HR, Finance, Legal, Operations—to create an exceptional employee experience that reflects our culture of innovation, agility, and wellbeing.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive benefits strategy that supports the company’s growth and employee value proposition across Latin America.
  • Act as the regional thought leader on benefits trends, market practices, and digital innovations in the Global Rewards space.
  • Collaborate with Global Rewards and HR leadership to ensure benefits design aligns with global benefits strategy and vision.
  • Consult and guide the benefits team members as well as our brokers on the strategy and objectives for the benefits function overall.

Program Design & Management

  • Design and manage benefits programs—including health, retirement, life, disability, and wellbeing—across multiple Latin American markets (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru).
  • Drive scalability and efficiency through regional harmonization, technology enablement, and vendor consolidation where appropriate.
  • Lead annual renewals, plan design changes, and benchmarking in partnership with global brokers and local consultants.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and performance metrics to ensure best-in-class service delivery.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, and Finance to maintain robust governance and operational accuracy.
  • Monitor legislative developments and assess their impact on program design and cost.

Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Develop compelling communication strategies that help employees understand and value their benefits.
  • Partner with internal communications, HR, and local teams to integrate benefits into broader employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Champion wellbeing, inclusivity, and flexibility in benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our workforce.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data and market insights to drive benefits strategy and cost management decisions.
  • Track and report key metrics related to participation, utilization, and employee satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and employee experience.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience with a leadership position managing employee benefits in a multi-country regional role across Latin America.
  • Proven success in benefits management within a highly matrixed, high-growth technology or multinational environment.
  • Deep understanding of regional benefits practices, legislation, and market dynamics.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.


Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Passion for innovation, technology, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors).
  • Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
  • Culturally fluent and adept at influencing across diverse teams.
  • Commitment to creating inclusive, employee-centered benefits programs.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We’re Flowmentum and our clients are fast-moving teams building reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure for companies shaping the future of AI, fintech, cloud services, and beyond.

Our engineers work on high-traffic, mission-critical systems that power millions of users across the globe.

We believe in autonomy, ownership, and solving hard problems — at scale. If you’re passionate about infrastructure done right, we want you on the team.



What You’ll Do:

  • Design and deploy cloud-native systems on AWS , that just work — at scale.
  • Own Kubernetes clusters : architecture, automation, observability, and performance tuning.
  • Build Terraform modules and GitOps pipelines to make deployments boring (in a good way).
  • Create CI/CD pipelines that are fast, reliable, and get new features into production safely.
  • Automate everything — provisioning, monitoring, security — with the best tools for the job.
  • Push systems to 99.99% uptime across billions of transactions a year.
  • Partner directly with product engineers, security, and leadership to ship infrastructure that accelerates growth.
  • Mentor teammates, review pull requests, and help define best practices as we scale.

You Should Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps , Cloud Engineering , or Site Reliability Engineering .
  • Strong Proven track record with LAMP (Linux Apache Mysql PHP)
  • Strong real-world experience with AWS , Kubernetes , and Terraform .
  • A deep understanding of Linux, containers, networking, and cloud-native security.
  • Proven ability to scale systems to handle high-volume , high-availability workloads.
  • Hands-on skills in scripting or coding — Python , Go , or Bash are all great.
  • An eye for automation and eliminating manual work wherever you find it.
  • Startup or growth-stage experience (bonus points).
  • Excellent async communication skills (Slack, GitHub, Docs).


Bonus Points If You’ve:

  • Built infrastructure for AI/ML systems, SaaS, or telco-scale apps.
  • Used tools like GitHub Actions , ArgoCD , Vault , Elastic Stack , or EKS .
  • Led technical teams or been a mentor for junior engineers.
  • Got certifications like AWS Solutions Architect, CKA, or Azure Admin.

title: Security Operations Center Analyst
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role:


We are seeking a technically skilled and proactive SOC Analyst – Level 2 with a focus on Operational Technology (OT) environments. This role involves handling escalated incidents, collaborating with platform teams, and enhancing threat detection logic across OT systems. The analyst will play a key role in supporting incident response and improving alert fidelity, particularly within platforms such as Nozomi Networks and Microsoft Sentinel.


What You’ll Do:

  • Create and maintain playbooks for automating incident response related to Nozomi alerts.
  • Enhance threat detection logic and perform false positive tuning to improve alert quality.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience in SOC operations, particularly in OT environments.
  • Hands-on knowledge of Nozomi Networks and Microsoft Sentinel platforms.
  • Familiarity with incident response workflows, playbook creation, and alert tuning.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work in a 24x7 operational environment and collaborate across teams.
  • Good communication skills and attention to detail.
  • English Advanced (B2/C1)
  • Certified in Microsoft (IT) and Nozomi (OT) (MANDATORY)

title: Security Operations Center Analyst
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role:


We are seeking a technically skilled and proactive SOC Analyst – Level 2 with a focus on Operational Technology (OT) environments. This role involves handling escalated incidents, collaborating with platform teams, and enhancing threat detection logic across OT systems. The analyst will play a key role in supporting incident response and improving alert fidelity, particularly within platforms such as Nozomi Networks and Microsoft Sentinel.


What You’ll Do:

  • Provide incident handling and escalation support for critical alerts, especially from the Nozomi platform.
  • Advise on security issue isolation and recommend remediation strategies.
  • Lead incident response and threat containment activities in OT environments.
  • Collaborate with the Nozomi platform team to fine-tune rules and reduce alert noise in Sentinel.
  • Create and maintain playbooks for automating incident response related to Nozomi alerts.
  • Enhance threat detection logic and perform false positive tuning to improve alert quality.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience in SOC operations, particularly in OT environments.
  • Hands-on knowledge of Nozomi Networks and Microsoft Sentinel platforms.
  • Familiarity with incident response workflows, playbook creation, and alert tuning.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work in a 24x7 operational environment and collaborate across teams.
  • Good communication skills and attention to detail.
  • English Advanced (B2/C1)
  • Certified in Microsoft (IT) and Nozomi (OT) (MANDATORY)


UST is waiting for you!

title: Paid Media Campaign Manager (Brazil)
description:
Paid Media Campaign Manager (Remote)

Location: Remote

Schedule: 40 hours per week, PST hours (flexible contract)

Employment Type: Contract

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate in USD, based on experience



About Adquadrant


Adquadrant is the AI-powered growth partner for modern consumer brands.


We help high-growth companies scale intelligently by transforming data, creative, and media into a connected intelligence system that learns and optimizes every day. Our approach unites four core pillars: Brand Intelligence, Media, Creative, and Measurement, all orchestrated through an AI framework that continuously adapts to performance signals and market shifts. At the center is Prism, Adquadrant’s AI intelligence engine that unifies data from every channel, identifies growth patterns, and powers real-time decision-making with precision and clarity. Through this connected model, we have helped next-generation brands generate over a billion dollars in attributable revenue and build lasting momentum in a constantly evolving market. The next era of growth is intelligent. Adquadrant builds the system behind it.


About the Role


We are seeking a Paid Media Campaign Manager who is comfortable managing cross-channel (Google, YouTube, Meta, TikTok, etc) paid media campaigns for US-based e-commerce and lead generation brands and is fanatical about AI usage to empower better and faster outcomes for clients.. You will handle day-to-day media execution across platforms, dive deep into performance data, and bring a test-and-learn mindset to every campaign.

This role is ideal for someone who is both a strategist and an operator, who thrives on solving complex performance challenges, enjoys building from 0 to 1, and knows how to connect data insights to creative opportunities.


Key Responsibilities


Campaign Management

  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Pmax, Shopping, Display, YouTube), Meta/Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and Microsoft Ads.
  • Manage and scale client budgets across multiple accounts, driving consistent ROAS and KPI achievement.
  • Analyze campaign data daily and adjust targeting, bidding, and creative to maximize performance.
  • Prepare performance reports using GA4, Looker Studio, Rockerbox, Supermetrics, and other attribution platforms.


Strategy & Innovation

  • Build and test strategies across new and emerging channels (e.g., Demand Gen, CTV, Retail Media).
  • Collaborate with creative and analytics teams to develop performance-driven media briefs.
  • Forecast and model potential performance outcomes using MMM, MTA, and cross-channel attribution data.


Client Collaboration

  • Partner closely with US-based teams and clients to align on objectives, budgets, and performance goals.
  • Present insights, strategic recommendations, and clear next steps in a client-facing capacity.
  • Proactively identify growth opportunities and communicate performance learnings.


Qualifications


  • 5+ years managing multi-channel paid media campaigns across both Paid Search and Paid Social.
  • Proven success optimizing toward ROAS, CPA, CPL, and revenue targets.
  • Experience managing large-scale budgets ($100K+/month) across multiple brands in the english speaking markets (US strongly preferred).
  • Proficiency with GA4, Rockerbox, Supermetrics, Looker Studio, or equivalent tools.
  • Understanding of forecasting, cross-channel attribution (MMM or MTA), and incrementality testing.
  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort translating data into actionable strategy.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; able to communicate clearly and professionally with US-based clients.
  • Detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple accounts independently.
  • Hands-on experience writing creative briefs and collaborating with creative teams.
  • Google Ads and Meta certifications preferred; TikTok, Pinterest, or LinkedIn certifications are a plus.


Ideal Candidate Profile


  • Managed $500K+ in monthly ad spend across a diverse portfolio of eCommerce clients.
  • Experience launching new channels or products from 0–1 with measurable success.
  • Skilled in reporting, visualization, and data storytelling through GA4 and Supermetrics.
  • Excels in environments that value data-driven decisions, intellectual curiosity, and collaboration.
  • Naturally curious, proactive, and eager to continuously test and learn.
  • Passionate about media innovation, AI-driven performance insights, and delivering measurable impact.

title: Senior Front-end Engineer (Browser Extension)
description:
We are looking for a remote Senior Front-end Engineer (Browser Extension) to develop and publish Chrome extensions for our U.S. client. The duration of this project will last 3-6 months with the opportunity to extend into a full-time position.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively implement formal security and privacy programs, measure the effectiveness of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality Chrome extensions that meet product and user requirements
  • Integrate Chrome Extension APIs to create seamless user experiences and efficient browser functionality
  • Collaborate with designers and back-end developers to ensure smooth data flow and consistent UI/UX
  • Debug, test, and optimize extensions for performance, compatibility, and scalability
  • Manage the full lifecycle of Chrome extensions, including publishing, version control, and updates in the Chrome Web Store
  • Stay current with evolving Chrome APIs and web development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of proven experience developing and publishing Chrome extensions
  • Solid understanding of Chrome Extension architecture and APIs (e.g., Manifest v3, background scripts, content scripts, messaging, and permissions)
  • Experience building interactive front-end components with .js
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Ability to write clean, modular, and maintainable code
  • Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and modern web development workflows
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, or related field
  • Experience with Node.js


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!
