description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
About Specialty Capital

Specialty Capital was founded just four years ago with a bold idea - to give “debanked” small businesses access to capital that’s Simple, Smart, and Reliable. Today, the company is among the top revenue-based finance companies in the U.S., serving thousands of merchants through a combination of speed, technology, and a deeply human approach. We’re now entering our next chapter and scaling into new financial verticals (credit cards, payments, and neo-bank integrations) and expanding internationally, starting with Canada. The company is profitable, founder-led, and growing rapidly with a culture built on grit, ownership, and mission.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Strategy

Mobile Application Architecture

Platform Development

  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes


Security & Compliance

  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies
  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures


Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical expertise in node.js, React, Swift, Java/Kotlin development
  • Review code, architectures, and technical designs to ensure quality and standards
  • Facilitate technical discussions and decision-making across teams

  • Strong expertise in Swift for iOS and Java/Kotlin for Android development

Preferred Qualifications

What We Offer

Specialty Capital is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!

Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.

  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.

title: Consultor(a) Funcional SAP PP/QM
description:
Consultor(a) SAP PP/QM Senior

Brasil - Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Estamos em busca de um consultor funcional altamente qualificado e experiente, especializado em SAP PP-PI (Planejamento da Produção para Indústrias de Processos) , REM (Manufatura Repetitiva) , MRP (Planejamento das Necessidades de Materiais) , Gestão da Qualidade (QM) e Arquivamento . O consultor será responsável pela documentação, gestão de cronogramas, implantação e suporte pós-implantação (hypercare) das funcionalidades liberadas, seguindo as metodologias e práticas de governança da PepsiCo. É essencial ter habilidade de comunicação eficaz em inglês, tanto falado quanto escrito. O profissional poderá estar localizado em qualquer país da região da América Latina (LATAM).


Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar e compreender os requisitos de negócio para projetar e implementar soluções SAP PP/QM que atendam às necessidades do cliente.
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos para usuários finais, garantindo a adoção bem-sucedida das soluções SAP PP/QM.
  • Realizar análise de processos de negócios e propor recomendações para melhorias.
  • Colaborar com os clientes para identificar e priorizar melhorias nos processos de planejamento da produção.
  • Desenvolver e manter a documentação das configurações, processos e procedimentos do SAP PP/QM.
  • Oferecer suporte contínuo e manutenção dos sistemas SAP PP/QM.
  • Executar testes, configurações, implementações e suporte pós-implantação (hypercare) das soluções.
  • Analisar e preparar objetos para arquivamento.


Habilidades e Qualificações:

  • Experiência comprovada em implementação, configuração e otimização de SAP PP/QM.
  • Sólido conhecimento em princípios e práticas de planejamento da produção.
  • Excelentes habilidades analíticas, de resolução de problemas e de comunicação.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma eficaz em equipes multifuncionais e de construir relacionamentos sólidos com colegas e usuários.
  • Certificações SAP PP/QM ou experiência equivalente (experiência prática em negócios é muito importante).
  • Forte compreensão do SAP ERP e integração com outros módulos (MM, WM, FICO).
  • Inglês técnico (falado e escrito).
  • Capacidade de atuar em múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.
  • Conhecimento sobre produção de bens de consumo.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em qualquer fuso horário da América Latina (México ou Brasil).
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA (desejável).
  • Ingles: avançado
  • Espanhol: intermediário/avançado


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação : Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

title: Fraud Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for a Fraud Risk Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on fraud prevention.

You'll act as the core fraud risk expert, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and design, implement, and oversee effective fraud controls across key local products.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Designing and enhancing fraud prevention controls within Brazil’s 1LoD framework, ensuring alignment with local BCB regulatory expectations and license requirements
  • Performing detailed fraud risk assessments across products (PIX, credit, cards, and business accounts), identifying control gaps and recommending practical mitigations
  • Leading the development and implementation of fraud prevention strategies, including creating and tuning transaction monitoring rules, leveraging data-driven models, and defining robust response workflows
  • Overseeing major fraud incidents and investigations, supporting containment, recovery, and required regulatory reporting processes
  • Partnering closely with Product and Data Science teams to improve automation, detection efficiency, and case triage logic, challenging the status quo for continuous improvement
  • Monitoring and analysing fraud trends and key performance indicators (KPIs) to produce actionable insights and dashboards for local management and committees
  • Strengthening fraud governance, ensuring clear documentation of risks, controls, and residual exposures to demonstrate control maturity during regulatory engagements


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in fraud risk management, prevention, detection, or Investigations within a financial institution or fintech
  • A deep understanding of fraud typologies, detection models, and control frameworks across payment and credit products (PIX, cards, credit)
  • Solid knowledge of local (BCB) FinCrime and fraud regulations and reporting obligations
  • Hands-on experience creating, tuning, and validating fraud detection rules and working with model performance metrics
  • Experience leading complex investigations end-to-end, identifying control weaknesses, and proposing remediation
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, connect data to risk impact, and design pragmatic, scalable solutions
  • A proven ability to partner with Product, Data Science, and Compliance teams to implement risk controls effectively
  • Great communication skills to relay complex fraud and regulatory topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Nice to have


  • Proficiency in using analytical tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Looker)
  • Confidence in presenting risk insights, fraud trends, and remediation updates
  • An interest in developing junior team members as the function scales


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations - SCM / Production Consultant
description:
Senior Dynamics 365 F&O Production & Supply Chain Consultant (Remote – Brazil)

Industry: Biotechnology

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract (Time & Materials - hourly)


About the Company

Join a global biotechnology leader transforming the future of life sciences through advanced research, sustainable manufacturing, and innovative digital technologies. As part of their large-scale operations expansion, the company is seeking a highly experienced Senior Dynamics 365 F&O Production & Supply Chain Management Consultant to strengthen their manufacturing and supply chain systems in preparation for global-scale D365 F&O roll out.


Role Overview

As the Senior D365 F&O SCM/Production Consultant , you will be the subject-matter expert for Production, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain modules. You will lead solution design, drive process optimization, and support global teams across complex, regulated environments. Your expertise will be critical in enhancing operational efficiency and ensuring the D365 platform supports end-to-end supply chain excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, configuration, and optimization of Production , Supply Chain Management , Warehouse Management , and Manufacturing modules in D365 F&O.
  • Collaborate with operations, supply chain, and manufacturing leaders to translate business challenges into scalable technical solutions.
  • Drive full lifecycle implementations and continuous improvement initiatives across global sites.
  • Provide expert guidance in areas such as BOMs, Routes, Master Planning, MRP, Production Control, Inventory Management, Procurement, and Quality.
  • Run requirements workshops, create functional documentation, guide testing cycles, and support go-live and hypercare phases.
  • Mentor junior consultants and ensure adherence to best practices in a regulated biotech setting.
  • Support integrations with MES, LIMS, warehouse automation, and supply chain planning tools where applicable.


Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience with Dynamics AX and/or Dynamics 365 F&O focused on Production and Supply Chain modules.
  • Deep knowledge of manufacturing processes, supply chain workflows, and operational best practices.
  • Proven leadership in multi-phase D365 ERP implementations or transformation programmes.
  • Strong communication skills in English; Portuguese or Spanish advantageous.
  • Ability to operate independently in a remote-first environment.
  • Must reside in Brazil .


Nice to Have

  • Experience in biotech, pharmaceutical, or other GMP-regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Exposure to MES integration, WMS solutions, or advanced planning systems.
  • Familiarity with Power Platform, Azure DevOps, and cross-functional D365 capabilities.


What’s on Offer

  • 100% remote role based in Brazil.
  • Opportunity to influence global manufacturing and supply chain operations in a global D365 F&O roll-out.
  • Work with a mission-driven bio-tech innovator.


How to Apply

If you are a seasoned Production & Supply Chain expert with strong D365 F&O experience, we’d love to connect. Apply now and help shape the digital backbone supporting groundbreaking biotech advancements.

title: Oracle EBS Order management Consultant/ 100% Remote in Brazil
description:
Job Profile: Oracle EBS Order management Consultant

Job Type: Long-time based contract Job Opportunity

Location: 100% Remote in Brazil

Job Description:


Main Activities:

  • Evaluates Oracle EBS Order Management suite of modules' functionality and provides solution recommendations to improve business processes, capabilities, and deliver proven value to Cummins
  • Serves as a subject matter expert and point of contact on content, processes, procedures, and functionality associated with Oracle Order Management suite of modules.
  • Primary Modules: Order Management, Advanced Pricing, Shipping Execution, Release Management and E-Commerce Gateway
  • Secondary Modules: iStore, Order Information Portal, Inventory, Quality, Bill of Materials and Costing
  • Partners with process owners, stakeholders and enterprise architects to gather, document and review functional, architecture and technical requirements
  • Define optimum application setup, high-level and detailed technical solution designs
  • Configure and verify EBS Modules to meet order to cash requirements and specifications
  • Design and oversee the development of integration customizations, workflows, and extensions
  • Work on the Analytics platform (built using Snowflakes) for dashboards and metrics

Competencies:

  • Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.
  • Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
  • Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  • Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
  • Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Tech savvy - Anticipating and adopting innovations in business-building digital and technology applications.
  • Solution Configuration - Configures, creates and tests a solution for commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) applications using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  • Solution Design - Creates and defines the solution design complete with instrumentation and measurement, using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to synthesize diagrams, models and documentation in order to build a solution that meets buildability, business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  • Solution Functional Fit Analysis - Composes and decomposes a system into its component parts using procedures, tools and work aides for the purpose of studying how well the component parts were designed, purchased and configured to interact holistically to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  • Solution Modeling - Creates, designs and formulates models, diagrams and documentation using industry standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  • Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Experience, Certification:

  • Degree on IT.
  • Fluent English.
  • Solid Experience (5+ yrs) in Oracle Order Management (EBS &/or Fusion) implementations (Advanced Pricing, Release Management and other EBS modules are highly beneficial))
  • Certification in Oracle Order Management (EBS or Fusion) is mandatory
  • Certification in Oracle Advanced Supply Chain Planning is highly beneficial
  • Robust (7 or more years) of system analysis and design experience is required. This should include the creation of functional requirements for enterprise-level business application solutions involving multi-tier client/server, database, or web-based applications.
  • Experience in the full software development lifecycle process.
  • Experiencing delivering solutions via AGILE methodologies is preferred.
  • Functional domain knowledge should include order management (order-to-cash) software applications and along with technical domain knowledge.

Durante os anos 1990, a consultoria iniciou um programa de expansão internacional, formando alianças estratégicas com organizações imobiliárias em todo o mundo, período em que se estabeleceu também no Brasil, maior mercado imobiliário da América Latina.

Fundada em 1997, a Binswanger Brazil nasceu como escritório regional da rede, e em pouco mais de duas décadas se consolidou como uma das principais fornecedoras de serviços imobiliários para o mercado corporativo brasileiro.

Com sede em São Paulo, a companhia conta atualmente com uma das melhores estruturas imobiliárias em operação no país e oferece assistência de alcance global para todo o território nacional em um balcão único para clientes em diversos setores da economia.

Mais do que atender às necessidades de clientes, a Binswanger Brazil oferece linha completa de soluções imobiliárias e projetos personalizados para atender a todas as etapas dos processos imobiliários de seus parceiros de negócio.

Em 2023 realizamos o que foi um marco significativo para o setor imobiliário, anunciamos a fusão entre a Binswanger Brazil e a SDS Properties. Nossa decisão, motivada pela oportunidade de combinarmos tecnologia, dados, relacionamentos e expertise de equipes altamente referenciadas, buscou potencializar ferramentas, inteligência de mercado, capacidade de inovação e consequentemente apresentar aos nossos clientes o mais alto nível de atendimento em Real Estate do país.


O QUE FAZEMOS:

Transações & Assessoria Imobiliária;

Consultoria & Avaliações de Imóveis;

Geo Soluções e Regularização Documental;

Gerenciamento de Projetos e Obras e;

Property e Asset Management.

A SAP FICO S/4HANA consultant specializes in implementing, configuring, and supporting the Finance and Controlling modules within the SAP S/4HANA environment. This involves working with business users to understand their needs, translating those needs into SAP solutions, and ensuring the system effectively supports financial processes. Lead or participate in the full lifecycle of SAP S/4HANA implementation projects, from planning and blueprinting to go-live and post-implementation support.

Business Analysis and Requirements Gathering:

Conduct workshops, gather requirements, and document business needs.

Design solutions that align with business requirements and best practices.

Testing and Training:

Provide end-user training on SAP FICO functionalities and processes.

Support and Maintenance:

Provide ongoing support for SAP FICO modules, including troubleshooting issues and resolving system errors.

Maintain and update documentation related to SAP FICO modules.

Support data migration activities and system upgrades.

Integration and Collaboration:

Collaborate with other IT teams and functional areas to ensure seamless integration of SAP FICO with other modules and systems.

Work with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve integration issues.

Subject Matter Expertise:

Act as a subject matter expert for SAP FICO, providing guidance and support to other team members and stakeholders.

Stay up-to-date with the latest SAP S/4HANA features and best practices.


Skills and Experience:

Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling modules.

Experience with SAP FICO configuration, implementation, and support.

Proficiency in business analysis, requirements gathering, and solution design.

Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.

Experience with data migration, testing, and training.

Knowledge of integration points with other SAP modules (e.g., SD, MM, PP).

Experience with Central Finance is a plus.

Experience with SAP Ariba and integrations is a plus.

Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud is a plus.

title: Investment Banking Junior Partner
description:
2024 Atlas Technology Boutique Investment Bank of the Year and VentureBeat Top 5 Tech M&A Firm, Ignatious, is seeking top tier candidates to expand its global junior execution team.


Role Description


In this role, you will work directly with some of the most experienced and highly renowned bankers in the world’s most important and disruptive sector — technology — supporting and executing high-profile M&A and private capital raise transactions. You will be a key part of small client teams delivering the highest quality work product and outcomes to some of the most prominent technology companies in the world.  We are not a 9-to-5 firm, we work late hours and weekends.  If you are motivated, curious by nature and aspire to crush it in an ambitious setting next to other high performers seeking to build a world class investment bank, we want to hear from you.


This is a front-office position that is fully remote, and requires close collaboration with our U.S., Caribbean, LatAm, and other team members across the globe. The right candidate will have a relentless work ethic, strong analytical and communication skills, and a passion for delivering precision work and unmatched client service in a high-pressure, entrepreneurial environment. 


Core Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English
  • +2 years of experience in front-office investment banking
  • Excellent analytical, financial modeling and critical thinking skills
  • Strong work ethic communication, presentation, problem-solving and negotiation skills
  • Strong PowerPoint Presentation skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented with a track record of achieving goals
  • Bachelors and or/master's degree in an analytical field from a reputed college
  • Affinity for current events, critical issues, and relevant news


Job Responsibilities


Advanced Financial Modeling & Analysis

  • Analyze and organize significant amounts of unstructured data to develop a coherent financial understanding of clients, the mechanics of their businesses and their historical performance 
  • Build from scratch and refine complex financial models (3-statement, DCF, LBO, accretion/dilution, etc.) to assess various capital structures, debt instruments, and valuation scenarios.
  • Develop strategic recommendations and support for creative transaction structures


Deal Execution Support

  • Collaborate directly with clients, advisors, and internal senior partners to provide regular updates on deal progress, outstanding issues, and strategic recommendations.
  • Coordinate due diligence processes (legal, financial, operational), monitoring timelines, and handling data flow among stakeholders.
  • Prepare transaction documentation including confidentiality agreements, term sheets, and final marketing materials for prospective investors or acquirers.


Pitchbook & Presentation Development

  • Craft high-impact pitch materials and management presentations, presenting complex financial data in an accessible and visually engaging format.
  • Continuously update standard client-facing materials with new market insights, recent transaction benchmarks, and emerging sector opportunities.


Market & Industry Research

  • Conduct in-depth industry analyses, monitoring key competitive trends, macroeconomic factors, and regulatory developments that may impact deal opportunities.


Mentorship & Team Coordination

  • Oversee and guide junior analysts in research, modeling best practices, and quality control, ensuring consistency and accuracy in all deliverables.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture by sharing knowledge, providing constructive feedback, and encouraging continuous learning.


Process Optimization & Best Practices

  • Evaluate current deal execution procedures, identifying process gaps and implementing improvements to streamline workflows.
  • Contribute to the creation and refinement of standardized templates, database resources, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to enhance team efficiency.


Compensation: 

  • Competitive Base Salary & Variable Compensation 
  • Significant Investment In Training, Mentorship and Professional Development 


Company Description

Specializing in M&A and private capital raise expertise, Ignatious helps technology companies achieve extraordinary financial outcomes in various verticals including AI/Artificial Intelligence (longstanding practice), Software, Mobility/Transportation, Consumer Internet, Health Care IT, FoodTech, AdTech/Marketing Tech, FinTech/Web 3.0, GovTech, and Prop Tech.


Ignatious is founded and led by Storm Duncan, former Global Head of Technology M&A at Credit Suisse and Jefferies. Storm has advised many of the most iconic companies and defining transactions in the technology sector including Google / YouTube / DoubleClick, Tencent / Universal Music Group, Microsoft, Apple / Drive.ai, Tinder / Match, Oracle / Sun / MySQL / RightNow, Uber / Careem, Lyft, AMD / NexGen, and AOL / DARPANET, amongst many others. His leadership is supported by a team of highly accomplished Senior Partners who previously led U.S. investment banking teams at J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, Deutsche Bank and Credit Suisse prior to joining Ignatious. 


If you are interested, please send CV to and / or apply on LinkedIn to ensure that you are considered for this role.

Retention Project Manager (Omnichannel | Customer Lifetime Value | AI Automation)

Are you passionate about enhancing customer experience and driving loyalty? We’re looking for a Retention Project Manager to lead and optimize omnichannel retention strategies that strengthen customer lifetime value across multiple touchpoints.

You will play a key role in developing, executing, and optimizing retention programs, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and driving data-informed decisions to improve post-purchase experience and reduce churn.

  • Analyze customer behavior, churn trends, and engagement metrics to identify growth opportunities and propose actionable improvements.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation to refine campaigns and improve conversion.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

A SAP FICO S/4HANA consultant specializes in implementing, configuring, and supporting the Finance and Controlling modules within the SAP S/4HANA environment. This involves working with business users to understand their needs, translating those needs into SAP solutions, and ensuring the system effectively supports financial processes. Support and Maintenance:

Maintain and update documentation related to SAP FICO modules.

Support data migration activities and system upgrades.

Integration and Collaboration:

Collaborate with other IT teams and functional areas to ensure seamless integration of SAP FICO with other modules and systems.

Work with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve integration issues.

Subject Matter Expertise:

Act as a subject matter expert for SAP FICO, providing guidance and support to other team members and stakeholders.

Stay up-to-date with the latest SAP S/4HANA features and best practices.


Skills and Experience:

Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling modules.

Experience with SAP FICO configuration, implementation, and support.

Proficiency in business analysis, requirements gathering, and solution design.

Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.

Experience with data migration, testing, and training.

Knowledge of integration points with other SAP modules (e.g., SD, MM, PP).

Experience with Central Finance is a plus.

Experience with SAP Ariba and integrations is a plus.

Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud is a plus.

title: AI Engineer | Agents
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Generativa (Generative AI Engineer) para ser uma peça-chave no desenvolvimento e evolução da nossa plataforma de Agentic AI .


Na Bren, não construímos chatbots genéricos. Nosso produto é uma plataforma avançada de múltiplos agentes (vendas, suporte, insights) que orquestra conversas de alta performance no WhatsApp. Você será responsável por projetar, construir e otimizar os "cérebros" por trás dessas interações, transformando dados brutos de conversas em vendas reais e experiências hiper-personalizadas.


Sobre a Bren

A Bren é uma startup inovadora que transforma conversas em vendas, se comunicando com os clientes através do WhatsApp, 24 horas por dia. Acreditamos que equipes de vendas são essenciais para o crescimento de uma empresa, e por isso criamos soluções de automação e comunicação que aumentam a produtividade e tornam os processos mais eficientes. Nossa plataforma oferece funcionalidades como agendamento de reuniões, campanhas inteligentes, follow-up automatizado e muito mais, sempre com a voz da marca e com a inteligência da IA.


Responsabilidades

Sua missão será evoluir a inteligência central da nossa plataforma:


  • Desenvolver a Arquitetura Multi-Agente: Projetar, implementar e otimizar os agentes de IA (vendas, suporte, insights) e a "camada de inteligência unificada" que os orquestra.
  • Otimizar a Tomada de Decisão: Desenvolver a lógica que permite aos agentes interagir com sistemas de terceiros (ex: gateways de pagamento, calendários, CRMs) para executar tarefas complexas, como um "Frictionless Shopping Journey" dentro do WhatsApp.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação: Manter-se na vanguarda das técnicas de IA Generativa, testando e implementando novas arquiteturas de agentes, modelos e frameworks para garantir a liderança tecnológica da Bren.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em conjunto com o time técnico (backend, frontend, e arquitetura) para integrar as capacidades de IA de forma escalável e segura na nossa infraestrutura (FastAPI + GCP).


Stack de IA e Ferramentas


  • Linguagem Principal: Python
  • Frameworks de IA: LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares
  • Modelos: Experiência prática com APIs de LLMs e/ou modelos open-source
  • Bancos de Dados: Experiência com Bancos Vetoriais (Vector Databases) (ex: Pinecone, Chroma, PGVector) e SQL
  • Backend & Infra: FastAPI, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)


Perfil Ideal


  • Experiência Central: Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e produção de sistemas de IA Generativa, especialmente com arquiteturas de agentes (Agentic AI) .
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Proficiência em Python e frameworks como LangChain (ou similares).
  • Domínio de RAG: Profundo conhecimento de técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) , embeddings e o uso de Vector Databases .
  • Visão de Produto: Capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócios complexos (como vendas conversacionais) em soluções de IA robustas e escaláveis.
  • Infraestrutura: Familiaridade com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (ou AWS/Azure), especialmente serviços relacionados a AI/ML.
  • Engenharia de Software: Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs (idealmente FastAPI ) e boas práticas de engenharia para colocar modelos em produção.
  • Diferenciais: Experiência prévia com a API da Meta (WhatsApp Cloud API) e Whatsapp Flow é um grande diferencial.


Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Projetar e desenvolver soluções ABAP que estendam a funcionalidade do SAP MDG, seguindo os princípios de Clean Core (utilizando BAdIs, extensibilidade para key users e extensões side-by-side).
  • Implementar e dar suporte a modelos de dados, workflows e validações no SAP MDG.
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais para coletar requisitos e propor soluções técnicas escaláveis e compatíveis com upgrades.
  • Desenvolver regras BRF+, interfaces baseadas em Fiori/UI5 e melhorias específicas do MDG utilizando frameworks de extensibilidade.
  • Garantir que todos os desenvolvimentos sejam compatíveis com os caminhos de upgrade do SAP S/4HANA.
  • Participar de code reviews, aplicando padrões de código limpo e diretrizes de extensibilidade SAP.
  • Apoiar integrações com sistemas externos utilizando APIs, OData e serviços do SAP BTP.
  • Fornecer consultoria técnica e suporte em debugging, troubleshooting e correção de erros para aplicações SAP customizadas.
  • Capacitar outros desenvolvedores, promovendo o compartilhamento de conhecimento e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar provas de conceito (PoCs) e projetos que envolvam tecnologias emergentes relacionadas ao ecossistema SAP.
  • Desenvolver e manter ferramentas, guidelines e processos que facilitem o trabalho do time de desenvolvimento SAP.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento ABAP, incluindo:
  • ABAP OO (Object-Oriented ABAP)
  • BAdIs e Enhancement Framework
  • BRF+
  • CDS Views
  • OData e APIs RESTful
  • SAP Fiori/UI5
  • Conceitos de Clean Core e práticas de extensibilidade SAP
  • Técnicas específicas de desenvolvimento para SAP S/4HANA
  • RAP (Restful ABAP Programming) — CDS, Annotations, Behavior Definitions, Managed/Unmanaged Implementation, EML
  • Experiência com SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) e Business Application Studio (BAS)
  • Conhecimento de Solution Manager (ChaRM, Focused Build)
  • Conhecimento em SAP Master Data Governance (MDG):
  • Modelagem de dados e frameworks de governança
  • INGLÊS AVANÇADO/FLUENTE


  • Habilidades comportamentais:
  • Capacidade analítica e foco em qualidade técnica
  • Colaboração com equipes funcionais e técnicas
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua e alinhamento com o conceito de Clean Core
  • Comunicação clara e espírito de equipe

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI-enabled digital services and applications. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team!


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


About You


  • Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
  • Proactive, always anticipating potential challenges and crafting solutions
  • Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
  • Professional level of English (written and spoken)
  • Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful—you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
  • You’re a people person and love finding ways to solve problems with creative ideas
  • Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
  • You love talking through ideas, offering feedback, and helping teams align with client goals
  • A background in marketing is essential
  • Nerdiness is a bonus! If you love D&D, Pokémon, video games, or books, we’ll get along just fine!


Purpose of the Role


The Marketing Coordinator role combines project coordination with client relationship management, acting as a bridge between internal teams and clients. This role supports smooth project execution by managing internal communication, task coordination, and ensuring that all client deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest standard. You'll be integral in managing both the marketing efforts and client interactions, translating client goals into actionable tasks, and ensuring the process runs seamlessly from start to finish.


Main Objectives


1-Client Collaboration & Project Oversight:

  • Collaborate with clients to understand their marketing goals and expectations.
  • Translate these goals into clear tasks for the Marketing Coordinator, ensuring smooth project execution.
  • Regularly meet with clients to review deliverables, adjust timelines, and maintain strong relationships.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing updates, addressing concerns, and ensuring satisfaction.


2-Internal Team Coordination:

  • Work closely with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other team members to develop high-quality marketing materials across all service offerings.
  • Organize internal kick-off meetings, assign tasks, and ensure that everything stays on schedule and within scope.
  • Provide clear direction and thoughtful feedback to internal teams to ensure work meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Ensure all project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp) and Teamwork boards are up to date.


3-Communication & Task Management:

  • Manage meetings with clients, ensuring clear action plans and next steps.
  • Review and approve final deliverables before submission, making sure they meet client goals and expectations.
  • Use tools like Jiminny to document meetings, share important notes, and ensure all action items are tracked.
  • Keep all teams aligned through regular check-ins and updates, making sure deadlines are met and no tasks fall through the cracks.


4-Resource Planning & Problem Solving:

  • Manage multiple projects at once, ensuring each one is progressing smoothly, with no delays or miscommunication.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, whether they relate to resources, deadlines, or client feedback.
  • Proactively anticipate problems and find creative solutions to keep projects on track.


5-Strategic & Process-Oriented Thinking:

  • Help shape the big-picture marketing strategy with the Senior Account Manager.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve internal workflows, ensuring efficiency and consistent delivery.
  • Build strong, positive relationships both within the team and with clients, helping to drive long-term success.


Additional Skills

  • Project Management: Skilled at managing timelines and juggling multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Verbal & Written Communication: Excellent communication skills—both internally and with clients.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Able to handle complex client personalities and stay calm under pressure.
  • Time Management: Proficient in balancing meetings, internal work, and client deliverables without missing a beat.
  • Presentation Skills: Comfortable leading client meetings and representing the agency confidently.


Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now—let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

Yeah, you heard that right. We’re seeking experienced, creative graphic designers to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.



What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for team players who live and breathe design. People who are creative powerhouses and thrive on pushing boundaries and finding ways to bring fresh ideas to life. Ready to join our team and start designing?

  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re a problem-solver, always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.

  • You’re a team player

Bonus Points


  • You worship Canva or other online tools like it’s your creative playground.

Se você busca desafios complexos, autonomia e a oportunidade de influenciar a arquitetura e as práticas de engenharia em escala, essa vaga é para você.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Diagnóstico e plano de ação para maturidade DevOps: mapear processos, ferramentas e práticas atuais, identificando gargalos e propondo um plano de evolução com prioridades claras para eficiência, automação e confiabilidade;
  • Estabilização e automação dos pipelines de CI/CD: puxar a revisão, padronização e automação de pipelines, garantindo versionamento, rastreabilidade e segurança das implantações, além de implementar práticas como blue/green deploy ou rollback automatizado;
  • Governança e confiabilidade dos ambientes: implementar processos e ferramentas que fortaleçam segurança, configuração e monitoramento, utilizando infraestrutura como código (ex.: Terraform), além de fomentar a cultura de observabilidade e resposta proativa a incidentes;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o time de DevOps e promover boas práticas de engenharia em toda a organização;
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de performance e disponibilidade em sistemas distribuídos.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis ;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CI/CD e automação (Jenkins, GitLab, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, ArgoCD, etc.);
  • Vivência em infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares);
  • Conhecimento avançado em linguagens de scripting/automação (Python, Ruby, Shell Script);
  • Linux avançado (obrigatório) e experiência com Windows Server;
  • Fundamentos de redes, protocolos e segurança ;
  • Experiência em cloud computing (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e boas práticas de otimização de custo/performance;
  • Containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes );
  • Experiência com monitoramento, logging e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog ou similares).



Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução tecnológica de um dos maiores ERPs do país, com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de usuários, queremos te conhecer!

title: Profissional QA Lead
description:

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (C#/.NET/React.js)
description:
We're looking for full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineers with 7+ years of experience delivering production-ready software. The ideal candidates will have recent hands-on C# /.NET, modern JS framework (Vue.js, React.js (preferred), Angular), and extensive end-to-end API and integration experience. You should thrive in fast-moving environments and be able to quickly translate ambiguous goals into working features, rapidly master new tools, and own your code from design through post-release support.

You'll collaborate with Senior and Staff engineers across North and South America, owning features from concept through production support and seeing users benefit almost immediately. If delivering practical solutions quickly and refining them in live environments motivates you, you'll fit right in.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution enhances brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations to result in lower costs, and boosts sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 restaurant locations utilize their technology today, processing more than $5 billion in payments annually.

  • Excellent written and spoken English; must be able to discuss trade-offs with teammates and stakeholders
  • 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years
  • Modern JavaScript framework experience, preferably React.js (Vue.js, OR Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs
  • Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts); whatever it takes
  • Must have "ownership mindset" - you'll have the responsibility of designing, building, shipping, monitoring, and fixing the features you touch
  • Fluent in Git and modern branching / PR workflows
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks
  • Team first approach displaying transparency, reliability, decisiveness, and a laser focus on customer impact
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human, let's learn from them - be transparent!

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. title: Director, Business Value Consulting
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Remote: Sao Paulo, Brazil
Your Career
In this Director Business Value Consulting role, you will build value-based business-cases for cybersecurity investment, by leading cross-functional teams composed of customer-executives, sales team, solution consultants, and other functional groups. You will have the opportunity to excel in areas of sales strategy, consultative discovery, and engagement execution including business analysis, problem solving, program management, executive communication and consensus building.

  • Support value-selling training initiatives across the sales ecosystem
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • 12+ years of experience, preferably with a top management consulting firm or technology company, focusing on business transformation
  • Expertise in building business cases with in-depth financial analysis and ROI/TCO modeling
  • Strong executive presence and situational awareness, with a proven track record of influencing C-suite leaders to drive key business decisions
  • Proven ability to foster accountability and build consensus across teams and customers, driving operational excellence and ensuring high-quality deliverables
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, applying consulting frameworks and methodologies, while offering creative solutions to drive executive decisions

The Team
Business Value Consulting is a strategic, consultative team that engages with Fortune 1000 and public sector customers to build and deliver strategic business justification as their cybersecurity partner. You will have the opportunity to excel in areas of sales strategy, consultative discovery, and engagement execution including business analysis, problem solving, program management, executive communication and consensus building.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: SAP Automation Developer QA/Tester
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Automation Developer QA/Tester who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and execute test concepts, automated or manual test script for cross platform mobile app SAP Service and Asset Manager and foundation framework Mobile Development Kit for Windows.

Follow SAP’s software quality standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in automation development and testing for mobile applications, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, with Behavior Driven Development, Java, JMeter, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system, Jenkins etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to clarify UI Figma design requirement for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows.

Document test concept, automation processes, test cases and workflows for reference and future improvement.

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to clarify OData Service features and requirement, to ensure sufficient test coverage.

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, with strong focus on usability, user experience, security, performance and feature correctness. Actively collaborate with frontend and backend developers to report functional issues, crashes, and performance problems, and validate fixes and resolution as required. Ensure test plant and results are maintained in the central Global Test Platform system for reporting and traceability.

Provide sufficient documentations on test environment, test results, re-produce steps

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) on any product documentation issues

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Maintain communication and documentation in English. Maintain proper communication and notification with SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Scrum Master SR
description:
Buscamos um(a) Scrum Master Sênior para atuar na criação de cadência para o time, promovendo entregas constantes com agilidade e foco em melhoria contínua dos processos. Você será facilitador(a) do fluxo de trabalho, parceiro(a) de PO e engenharia, e referência em cultura ágil orientada a valor e métricas.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Estabelecer e sustentar a cadência do time, facilitando rituais e garantindo fluxo de trabalho.
  • Promover entregas constantes com agilidade, orientando por métricas (lead time, throughput, WIP, CFD) e foco em valor.
  • Conduzir melhoria contínua, ajustando processos e eliminando desperdícios.
  • Antecipar e remover impedimentos/dependências, alinhando PO, times técnicos e stakeholders e fortalecendo um ambiente de alta performance.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência como Scrum Master em produtos/tecnologia.
  • Domínio de Scrum e Kanban, técnicas de facilitação, gestão de fluxo e métricas ágeis; vivência em discovery e delivery.
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação, influência sem autoridade, mediação de conflitos e coaching de times.
  • Prática com ferramentas como Jira/Confluence e Miro/Mural.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Especialista de Tecnologia – Dados & Analytics
description:
Responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar processos de coleta, tratamento e análise de grandes volumes de dados, transformando informações em insights estratégicos que apoiem a tomada de decisão em todas as áreas da empresa. Atua com ferramentas de Data Warehousing, Data Factory e Power BI, assegurando a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados corporativos, além de acompanhar tendências como o Microsoft Fabric.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar a coleta, transformação e integração de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de ETL e pipelines de dados;
  • Estruturar e manter ambientes de dados (Data Lake, Data Warehouse) garantindo desempenho, governança e escalabilidade;
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar conjuntos de dados e modelos analíticos para relatórios e dashboards interativos no Power BI;
  • Aplicar técnicas de análise avançada, modelagem estatística e machine learning para geração de insights preditivos e prescritivos;
  • Garantir a governança, qualidade e segurança das informações, assegurando conformidade com normas e legislações como LGPD e GDPR;
  • Automatizar processos de integração e análise de dados, promovendo eficiência e inovação contínua;
  • Colaborar com equipes de negócio e tecnologia para identificar oportunidades de uso estratégico dos dados e apoiar iniciativas de transformação digital.


Requisitos e Certificações:

  • Experiência sólida em engenharia e análise de dados, com domínio de Power BI, Azure Data Factory e Data Warehousing;
  • Certificações Microsoft DP-900 (Fundamentos de Dados) e DP-700 (Power BI) são altamente desejáveis;
  • Conhecimento ou interesse em Microsoft Fabric será considerado um diferencial estratégico;
  • Certificação DP-203 (Data Engineering on Azure) é um diferencial para compreender e evoluir pipelines legados.

title: Analista de Quality Assurance Pleno
description:
Quem somos

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção digital global, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, a Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


Sobre a Vaga

Você será responsável por entregar projetos digitais “limpos”, seguindo planos de testes e criando tickets de bugs impecáveis, conforme os protocolos de qualidade global. Também será responsável pela garantia de qualidade com foco na funcionalidade e compatibilidade dos projetos analisados. Os tickets de bugs registrados devem ser escritos do ponto de vista técnico e podem incluir sugestões de correções ou soluções alternativas. Nossos projetos são baseados principalmente em ações de marketing focadas em e-mails marketing e banners que precisam estar em conformidade com os diferentes navegadores, sistemas operacionais e dispositivos, garantindo o correto carregamentos em todos eles.


Responsabilidades

• Garantir que a equipe de desenvolvimento tenha sempre a lista de todos as versões de dispositivos, sistemas operacionais e navegadores que serão usados nos testes para garantir uma entrega de qualidade.

• Assumir a propriedade dos projetos de controle de qualidade atribuídos desde o início até à entrega;

• Executar planos eficazes para controle de qualidade, revisão e auditorias, entregando projetos “limpos” e livres de bugs;

• Contribuir para o design e validar a funcionalidade dos conceitos de design;

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com gerentes de projetos e desenvolvedores para garantir a qualidade e a conclusão dos projetos no prazo;

• Desenvolver materiais de boas práticas para que os demais grupos adjacentes à tecnologia realizem suas verificações de qualidade em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do projeto.


Pré-requisitos

• Experiência com campanhas digitais com testes em E-mails e Banners;

• Bacharel em Desenvolvimento de Software, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;

• Inglês avançado (seu time de contato direto será global);

• Certificação em Doubleclick Banner (desejável);

• Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Analista de Quality Assurance ou UX;

• Conhecimento dos principais navegadores da Internet, capaz de usar Mac e PC, ter conhecimento de plug-ins de navegador como JavaScript, Flash, etc., familiarizado com tablets (Android, iPad) e smartphones;

• Experiência em ambiente de agencia de publicidade, ou similar.


Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00
