title: Audio Transcription Specialist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


Job Title: Audio Transcription Specialist (Language: Portuguese, Location: Portugal)


About The Role:

We are seeking detail-oriented and dedicated professionals with hands-on experience in audio transcription and quality assurance . The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurately converting audio content into written text, maintaining high standards of accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Listen carefully to audio recordings and transcribe them into clear, accurate, and grammatically correct text .
  • Identify and correct transcription errors , ensuring proper spelling, punctuation, and formatting.
  • Handle different accents, speech clarity levels, and background noises with attention to detail.
  • Tag and label transcriptions as per project guidelines.
  • Review, proofread, and edit transcripts for quality, accuracy, and completeness .
  • Follow client-specific formatting and delivery instructions.
  • Work closely with project leads and QA teams to meet daily quality and productivity targets .
  • Maintain confidentiality and data security of all content handled.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in audio transcription or related linguistic work.
  • Excellent command of English (or other project-specific language) with strong grammar and listening skills.
  • Good typing speed and accuracy with familiarity in transcription tools or software.
  • Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines .
  • High attention to detail and ability to follow formatting guidelines strictly.
  • Must have a reliable internet connection, functional laptop/desktop, and good-quality headphones (mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in AI training, transcription QA, or linguistic data projects .
  • Familiarity with timestamping, labeling, or annotation tasks .
  • Experience working with global transcription platforms or large-scale linguistic projects.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text software and audio editing tools is an added advantage.

Experiência com streaming em tempo real (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis).

Conhecimentos em containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

Experiência com catálogos de dados, metadata management e ferramentas de governança.

Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara a públicos não técnicos.

title: Product Owner – Loyalty & Marketing Automation (Contract/Freelance - 6 to 9 months - LATAM)
description:
We’re seeking a hands-on Product Owner to drive the implementation of Loyalty and Marketing Automation platforms for LATAM markets.

You’ll be the bridge between marketing teams and technical delivery groups, ensuring business needs are translated into clear, actionable features.


What you’ll do

  • Own and prioritize the product backlog for Loyalty and Marketing Automation initiatives.
  • Write clear epics , user stories , and acceptance criteria ; maintain documentation in Confluence .
  • Collaborate with global and local teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions.
  • Support integration with the Single Customer View (SCV) and ensure data governance best practices.
  • Facilitate agile ceremonies and ensure timely, value-driven delivery.


What we’re looking for

  • 5–8 years’ experience as a Product Owner , Business Analyst , or similar in marketing tech or CRM.
  • Strong grasp of Agile methodology and sprint management.
  • Familiarity with MarTech tools – CDPs, loyalty/promo engines, and automation platforms.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and Spanish or Portuguese .
  • Agile certification (CSPO, SAFe PO/PM) is a plus.

title: Senior PPC Specialist (Home-office)
description:
We are looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to join our remote team in Brazil. The ideal candidate has a strong track record in paid media and deep expertise in data-driven performance strategies.


Responsibilities:

  • Plan, execute, and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram), LinkedIn, and TikTok.
  • Analyse KPIs and suggest improvements focused on performance (ROAS, CPA, CTR, etc.).
  • Conduct A/B tests and implement learnings in real time.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 4 years’ experience managing PPC campaigns.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Data Studio.
  • Google Ads and Meta certifications are a plus.
  • Strong analytical mindset, self-driven, and results-oriented.
  • Advanced English (reading, writing, and speaking) is mandatory.


What we offer:

  • Contractor model (CNPJ) with a monthly compensation of AUD 2,916 (~R$10,200).
  • 100% remote position.
  • 20 paid vacation days per year.
  • Flexible working hours, with occasional alignment to Australian time zones.
  • International work culture focused on autonomy, continuous learning, and professional growth.


Interested candidates should submit an updated resume along with examples of previous campaign results.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
WHO ARE WE?


We’re a fast-growing consumer brand group selling across e-commerce, TikTok Shop, and Amazon. We prioritize direct-response strategy, product quality, and measurable efficacy. The team moves fast and operates with a high bar.


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We’re hiring a Creative Strategist with heavy direct response experience.


You’ll own both strategy and ops: building and briefing angles, scripting iterations, managing sprints, reviewing edits, and ensuring we ship 100–200 ads per week.


You must have lived and breathed direct response advertising and VSL-style creative—knowing the beats, pacing, proof, and psychology that drive conversions. This is a hands-on IC role with pod-level ownership (no formal people management).


Focus split:

● ~60% Strategy/Briefing

● ~40% Creative Ops/QA/Delivery


HOW TO APPLY: If you believe we're the right fit, please fill in this form:


WHAT WILL YOU DO?


Direct Response Strategy / Briefing / Analysis

● Develop a creative strategy by offer, funnel, and awareness stage; publish weekly test plans.

● Generate net-new DR angles from learnings, competitor swipes, and cultural trends.

● Outline 2–3 minute VSL-style ads (problem, agitation, solution, proof, CTA) and collaborate with copy on scripting.

● Write iteration briefs (hook swaps, lead/body edits, CTA tests, packaging, captions) with clear hypotheses.

● Brief content creators with DR talking tracks, shot lists, compliance guardrails, and demo guidelines.

● Lead reviews to ensure DR structure, pacing, and storytelling are dialed in.

● Translate performance data (Hook, Hold, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS) into new test briefs within 1–3 days.


Creative Ops & Delivery

● Own weekly sprints: intake → brief → production → QA → launch → iteration.

● Plan and ship 100–200 ads weekly (mix of new and iterations).

● Traffic assets correctly: naming, specs (9:16 / 4:5 / 1:1), captions, UTMs.

● QA assets for typos, compliance, pacing, audio, and render quality.

● Review editor work with time-stamped, DR-specific notes (cut logic, proof beats, motion/graphics, sound).

● Maintain a clean, searchable DAM with version control.

● Coordinate with Media/Growth to ensure launches hit deadlines.

● Use light automation/AI for cut-downs, resizing, and captions.

● Track throughput and ensure weekly volume targets are met without errors.

● Manage creator usage rights and content expirations.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 90 DAYS)

● 100–200 DR ads shipped weekly , >98% QA pass rate .

● Iterations launched within 24–48 hours of insights , increasing win rate.

● Faster time-to-first-winner and more winners per 50 launches.

● A standardized system for DR briefs (VSL, creator, iteration) used by the team.

● Clean DAM and clear creative pipeline visible to Growth/Media .


MUST-HAVES

● 3+ years in direct response creative strategy, ideally in high-spend environments ($1MM+/mo).

● Deep experience with VSL-style ads : structure, beats, proof, pacing, CTA flow.

● Proven ability to ship 100–200 ads weekly across VSLs, short-form, and UGC.

● Strong post-production literacy (Premiere/Final Cut/AE basics) for precise DR feedback.

● Track record of writing/briefing iterations and content creators for DR assets .

● Data-driven mindset; you live in Hook/Hold/CTR/CPC/CPA/ROAS.

● Detail-oriented; errors don’t slip past you.

● Clear communicator who pushes creative toward DR performance.


NICE-TO-HAVES

● Health, beauty, or OTC-adjacent experience.

● Amazon and TikTok Shop creative systems.

● Familiarity with tools: ClickUp/Asana, Frame.io, Motion/Varos, Google Workspace, CapCut/Descript, Runway/Topaz/ElevenLabs


HOW TO APPLY: If you believe we're the right fit, please fill in this form:

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Partner Enablement Consultant
description:
About Zensar Technologies

Zensar is a leading digital solutions and technology services company partnering with global organizations on their digital transformation journey. A technology partner of choice, with strong track-record of innovation, credible investment in digital solutions and assertion of commitment to client’s success, Zensar’s comprehensive range of services and solutions enable clients achieve new thresholds of performance. Part of the $40 billion APAX Partners’ portfolio of companies, Zensar is uniquely positioned to help existing businesses run efficiently, manage legacy transformation and plan business growth through innovative digital platform.

Working at Zensar

Working at Zensar is an enriching experience. While work is driven by innovation and passion, fun is taken seriously too. An open environment is encouraged making it easy to brainstorm with colleagues. Creative thinking is encouraged through time out activities. Moreover, the offices have been designed to foster creativity and communication, bringing a little bit of home into work every day. Zensar provides and a comprehensive benefit package for all fulltime employees.


Indigo Slate@ Zensar Company is seeking a Partner Enablement Consultant in Brazil (Remote). This is open for Full time remote with outstanding growth opportunities. All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.


Job Description

Consultants are responsible for advising, guiding, scoping, developing strategic learning plans that align to channel partner business teams and their outcomes, with a strong ability to get buy-ins from senior business stakeholders. Consultants act as SMEs for client learning programs (such as certification, products, offerings, tools, processes, training, and exams) and work with technology, L&D and business teams to drive partner workforce capacity and capability by aligning to measurable business outcomes.

Self-driven, analytical, and strategic thinkers—who also have excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to develop and execute plans—will succeed in this consultative role.

T

his is not a role in instructional design, curriculum/content development or training delivery or

operations.


High-level skills and experience

• Strong consultative mindset and consulting skill set with a strong point-of-view on solutions and

recommendations.

• Strategic, ‘big picture’ thinking and connecting the dots.

• Ability to understand the ‘why’ along with the ‘what’ and ‘how’ of a partner need (i.e., well- rounded learning plans that drive business outcomes rather than just chasing headcount/numbers)

• Strong commercial awareness/business acumen of the client’s and channel partner’s business.

• Ability to align learning with client and partner ROI and business drivers.

• Thought leadership with new ideas, strategies, framework, processes to drive results.

• Executive presence and comfortable with public speaking (in-person and virtual) with senior

stakeholders and large audiences

• Data analytics (ability to dig into trends and forecast) and data story telling.

• Technical prowess to understand data/AI/cloud/technical knowledge.

• Highly collaborative across various business functions/senior stakeholder management.

• Proactive and independent, ability to excel in a fast-paced environment while working from vision through execution.


Expected tasks and responsibilities

• Execute frameworks to assess capability and capacity workforce skill gaps in partner organizations.

• Conduct partner needs analysis (discovery and scoping at business, technical and learning levels)

• Enabling consulting conversations with business leaders in partner teams to understand their

business drivers.

• Propose strategic learning plans to all internal and external stakeholders.

• Prescribe relevant learning based on scope and workload (such as certifications, solutions, products,

etc.)

• Build custom partner learning plans, where required, based on the results of scoping/needs analysis and business priority.

• Monitor learner progress and detect any issues.

• Create and present Quarterly/Monthly Business Reviews with senior L&D/Business/Technology

stakeholders

• Monitor and analyze learning stats for data-driven decisions.

• Explore business problems and create different solution models.

• Make recommendations for improvement and present to partners and internal stakeholders.

• Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Qualifications/Requirements

We are looking for individuals with the following qualifications, skills, and experiences:

• 5+ years relevant experience being an L&D consultant or in any business facing consultant role driving outcomes.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Computer Science, or a related field (required)

• Masters candidates (preferred)

• Cloud Digital Leader or Generative AI Leader (GAIL) certifications, preferred but not mandatory

• Experience in the channel partner ecosystem highly preferred


All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.

Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Zensar encourages our employees to seek higher education and training. However, this position will require you to be completely available during work hours.

Zensar is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women. title: Webflow Designer
description:
SOBRE A LETS


A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras. Nosso sistema SaaS, chamado Max, é a espinha dorsal que conecta varejistas, operadores logísticos e canais de venda de forma eficiente e automatizada, oferecendo uma experiência simplificada e eficaz para todos os envolvidos. Nossa missão é desenvolver soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que maximizem o desempenho e a eficiência dos negócios, capacitando empresas a alcançar resultados excepcionais.


Estamos crescendo rapidamente e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte de nossa jornada, ajudando a transformar o ecossistema de tecnologia e logística para negócios. Se você é uma pessoa com olhar apurado para produto digital, experiência do usuário e front-end em plataformas low-code/no-code como o Webflow , a LET'S é o seu lugar!


SOBRE A VAGA


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Webflow & Experiência Digital para liderar a evolução do nosso site, blog, landing pages e hubs de conteúdo — conectando marca, performance e produto em uma experiência consistente.


É um papel híbrido entre UX/UI Designer e Front-end Low-Code : alguém que entende jornada, navegação, hierarquia de informação, microcopy e conversão, mas também entra no Webflow para estruturar coleções dinâmicas, componentes, interações, integrações e ajustes finos de layout, responsividade e performance.


Você será “dono(a)” do nosso ecossistema Webflow (e ferramentas associadas), garantindo que tudo esteja organizado, escalável e fácil de manter, sempre conectado com times de Marketing, Growth, Produto e Vendas.


ATIVIDADES:


  • Arquitetura e UX do site : estruturar menus, páginas, fluxos, componentes e coleções (CMS) alinhados à estratégia da LETS e dos produtos (Max SalesCloud, Bippi, FiboNash, etc.).
  • Implementação no Webflow : construir e manter páginas, layouts, coleções dinâmicas, formulários, interações, animações e variações responsivas (mobile-first).
  • Design System & consistência visual : organizar estilos globais (tipografia, cores, grids, componentes), garantindo coerência entre site, blog, LPs e materiais digitais.
  • Performance & SEO On-page : otimizar estrutura, headings, imagens, meta tags, URLs, links internos e boas práticas Core Web Vitals.
  • Integrações & low-code : configurar integrações com ferramentas como HubSpot, AirOps, n8n, WhatsApp/API, analytics, pixels e outros conectores sem depender sempre de dev.
  • Experimentação & conversão : propor e testar variações de páginas, CTAs, formulários e mensagens para melhorar conversão, engajamento e qualificação de leads.
  • Criação de estruturas de landing pages: desenvolver e criar modelos de landing pages escaláveis para eventos, material RICO, e outras formas de conteúdo.
  • Documentação & escalabilidade : registrar padrões, boas práticas e guidelines para que o ecossistema Webflow seja sustentável, organizado e fácil de evoluir.
  • Curiosidade técnica : explorar novas features, clonables, bibliotecas e soluções low-code/no-code que ajudem a levar o site “um passo além” sempre.


REQUISITOS:


Eliminatórios (OBRIGATÓRIO):

  • Experiência comprovada (3+ anos) construindo sites, LPs e projetos profissionais em Webflow .
  • Domínio de UX/UI básico a intermediário : wireframes, hierarquia de informação, boas práticas de navegação e usabilidade.
  • Conhecimento sólido de HTML e CSS (para ajustar o que o Webflow gera e criar soluções mais refinadas).
  • Noções de JavaScript suficientes para pequenas interações, embeds e integrações simples.
  • Experiência com design responsivo e otimização para mobile.
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de documentação técnica, tutoriais e comunidades (inclusive em inglês).
  • Perfil hands-on, curioso, autônomo , com vontade de testar, fuçar, perguntar (inclusive para IAs) e aprender rápido.


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:


  • Experiência com Figma ou ferramenta similar para prototipação.
  • Familiaridade com integrações Webflow ↔ HubSpot , formulários, CRM, automações (n8n/Make/Zapier).
  • Conhecimento em SEO técnico , Analytics, Tag Manager e pixels.
  • Vivência com marcas B2B SaaS, logística, e-commerce ou last-mile.
  • Noções de motion design (Lottie, microinterações, GSAP ou similar).
  • Noções de A/B testing , CRO e métricas de funil.
  • Espanhol ou inglês intermediário.


BENEFÍCIOS:


  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados .
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico .
  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:


  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .
  • Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).
  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .


Como se destacar:

Envie portfólio com projetos em Webflow (links públicos ou clonables), mostrando:

  • antes/depois, raciocínio de UX e decisões de layout;
  • exemplos de coleções dinâmicas, componentes reutilizáveis e interações;
  • casos em que você integrou Webflow com outras ferramentas (CRM, automações, forms, etc.);
  • breve explicação do seu processo (como você estuda, testa, aprende e resolve problemas sozinho(a)).

title: Closer de Vendas
description:
CONDIÇÕES DA VAGA:


100% Home Office.

Pessoa Jurídica (MEI).

Dedicação exclusiva em 8 horas diárias de trabalho.

Remuneração fixa iniciando em R$1.500,00 podendo ir até R$2.000,00 + variável em % sobre as vendas.

Nossa agência está buscando um prestador(a) de serviços Closer de Vendas, para integrar nossa equipe e atuar como ponto focal entre a agência e nossos clientes. Buscamos um profissional com excelente habilidade de comunicação, capacidade de resolver problemas e comprometimento em oferecer a melhor experiência para os clientes.

Experiência ou curso/formação na área de Vendas.

Cursos de atendimento ao cliente ou curso superior na área de Marketing ou administração será considerado um diferencial.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal em português.

Habilidade para resolver problemas e lidar com situações adversas.

Domínio de ferramentas de CRM, gestão de projetos e pacote Office.

Comprometimento com a excelência no atendimento e satisfação do cliente.

Espírito de equipe e habilidade para trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Principal Consultant – SOC Transformation and XSIAM Deployment
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.
Your Impact
  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD/MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM/security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel
Additional Information
Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. But you won’t wait for them to be raised, you’ll seek them out, too. We fix and identify technical problems with a pointed focus of providing the best customer support in the industry.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly driven Product Manager to lead the end-to-end development of Pointsville’s digital products. You’ll turn ideas into impactful solutions by connecting business goals, user needs, and technical execution. This role focuses on defining vision, setting priorities, and delivering products that drive growth, innovation, and long-term value across emerging technologies and financial ecosystems.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with company goals.
  • Conduct market and competitor research to identify new product opportunities and emerging trends.
  • Gather and analyze requirements from users, partners, and internal stakeholders to inform product design and prioritization.
  • Translate business and technical needs into clear product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage and continuously refine the product backlog, balancing priorities and timelines across multiple initiatives.


Execution and Delivery

  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to create user-centric designs and intuitive experiences.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution of product features and releases.
  • Lead product launches, define success metrics, and coordinate enablement with marketing, sales, and support teams.


Performance and Improvement

  • Monitor product performance post-launch, analyze user feedback, and drive continuous improvement and iteration.
  • Work closely with compliance and legal teams to ensure all product features adhere to regulatory requirements in the crypto and financial services space.
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment, ensuring all teams are informed, empowered, and accountable.
  • Support documentation, go-to-market readiness, and internal communication for each product phase.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of experience in product management, preferably in fintech or financial services, with direct crypto experience.
  • Demonstrated success of launching and scaling successful web and/or enterprise products from concept to launch.
  • Experience with varying development methodologies and leading cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, fintech, or emerging financial technologies preferred.
  • Skilled in data-driven decision making using metrics and analytics tools.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical conversations.
  • High user empathy, strong prioritization abilities, and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Marketing Cloud Senior Developer - Salesforce
description:
Marketing Cloud Senior Developer - Salesforce


Visão Geral da Posição

O Desenvolvedor Sênior de Marketing Cloud será responsável por desenvolver soluções dentro da plataforma Salesforce Marketing Cloud para apoiar funções críticas de negócio e atender aos requisitos de projetos.

Essa função exige uma combinação sólida de proficiência técnica, pensamento criativo e atenção aos detalhes . O profissional colaborará de perto com equipes de marketing, design, dados e gestão de campanhas para entregar experiências digitais impactantes que envolvam milhões de clientes.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implantar soluções complexas de automação de marketing utilizando o Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Cloud Pages e Mobile Studio).
  • Implementar personalização e segmentação baseadas em dados , utilizando Data Extensions, consultas SQL e lógica AMPscript .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar Cloud Pages, formulários e landing pages integradas aos dados e APIs do Marketing Cloud.
  • Criar e manter jornadas e automações para campanhas gatilhadas, comportamentais e de ciclo de vida .
  • Projetar e implementar fluxos de integração de dados entre o SFMC e outros sistemas (Sales/Service Cloud, CDP ou fontes de dados externas).
  • Criar e gerenciar Data Extensions, atividades de consulta e processos de automação para garantir fluxo de dados eficiente.
  • Trabalhar com APIs (REST/SOAP) e Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) para integrações avançadas e conteúdo dinâmico.
  • Seguir padrões de codificação e melhores práticas dentro do ecossistema Marketing Cloud.
  • Atuar como especialista técnico (SME) em todos os trabalhos de desenvolvimento relacionados ao SFMC.
  • Colaborar com arquitetos e equipes de operações de marketing para impulsionar melhorias na plataforma e implementar novas funcionalidades.
  • Trabalhar com as equipes de marketing e design para transformar conceitos criativos em soluções tecnicamente viáveis.
  • Revisar códigos e orientar desenvolvedores juniores , garantindo escalabilidade, performance e manutenibilidade.
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas técnicos , otimizando para velocidade, confiabilidade e engajamento.
  • Supervisionar testes de renderização e entregabilidade utilizando ferramentas como o Litmus .
  • Manter altos padrões de privacidade de dados, conformidade (CAN-SPAM, GDPR) e segurança.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de analytics para estabelecer rastreamento de performance, relatórios e insights a partir dos dados do SFMC.
  • Avaliar continuamente novos recursos do SFMC, atualizações e melhores práticas do mercado para aprimorar as capacidades da plataforma.
  • Explorar e implementar recursos de IA, personalização e inteligência preditiva dentro do Marketing Cloud.


Habilidades e Experiência:

  • Graduação em TI, Ciência da Computação ou área equivalente , com 7 a 10 anos de experiência em TI e mínimo de 5 anos com Salesforce Marketing Cloud .
  • Conhecimento aprofundado da plataforma Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) e compreensão dos conceitos essenciais de e-mail marketing e automação .
  • Experiência com Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automations, SQL, Content Builder e criação de audiências para Advertising Studio .
  • Proficiência em HTML, CSS, JavaScript e AMPscript para desenvolvimento de e-mails.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e experiência em testes e depuração de e-mails usando o Litmus .
  • Compreensão das melhores práticas da Salesforce para automação de marketing .
  • Capacidade e vontade de trabalhar com alto grau de autonomia e senso de propriedade em uma equipe geograficamente distribuída , composta por outros desenvolvedores e recursos de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal .

title: Sap Quality Management Consultant

SAP QM Consultant (Contract) – Pharma Industry / LIMS Integration


Location: Brazil – Remote / Hybrid (depending on project)

Contract Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

Duration: 12 months (extendable)


About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced SAP QM Consultant (Contractor) to support SAP S/4HANA implementation and enhancement projects for clients in the pharmaceutical sector .

The consultant will play a key role in designing and configuring SAP QM processes, ensuring seamless integration with LIMS (Laboratory Information Management Systems) , and maintaining compliance with GxP and pharmaceutical quality standards .

This is an excellent opportunity for independent SAP professionals who enjoy project-based work, flexibility, and the chance to collaborate in a global, regulated environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Configure and support SAP QM processes (inspection lots, results recording, batch management, certificates).
  • Design and manage SAP–LIMS integrations (LabVantage, LabWare, or equivalent).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (PP-PI, MM, WM/EWM) to align manufacturing and quality processes.
  • Ensure full GxP compliance and support validation, testing, and documentation.
  • Participate in template design, rollouts, and process improvements across global sites.
  • Provide training, functional support, and issue resolution during cutover and go-live.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of proven experience as an SAP QM Consultant .
  • Strong background in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.
  • Hands-on LIMS integration experience (e.g., LabVantage, LabWare, etc.).
  • Working knowledge of S/4HANA , IDoc/qRFC/Web Services , and interface technologies .
  • Understanding of GMP/GxP validation and quality control processes.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is an advantage).
  • Availability to work remotely or hybrid within Brazil under a contractor model (PJ or freelance) .

title: Engenheiro(a) De Software Backend Pleno - Ruby on Rails
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O(A) Engenheiro(a) De Software Backend Pleno - Ruby será responsável por:

Implementação de Soluções

  • Escrever e implementar código conforme requisitos.
  • Garantir qualidade e usabilidade do produto.
  • Testar e depurar em diferentes ambientes.
  • Contribuir em decisões de arquitetura e design.
  • Revisar código para manter padrões de qualidade.
  • Integrar componentes de software.
  • Estimar tarefas junto ao Líder Técnico e PM, utilizando métricas da equipe.


Sustentação dos Sistemas

  • Resolver chamados (erros e dúvidas).
  • Executar scripts e relatórios de apoio.
  • Garantir segurança e privacidade dos dados com apoio e revisão dos líderes e pares.
  • Participar de war rooms com TL e/ou PM.
  • Atuar pela estabilidade do sistema com SRE e TL, respondendo a alertas e prevenindo falhas.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento backend com Ruby on Rails em ambiente de produção.
  • Vivência em arquitetura de sistemas web escaláveis, considerando boas práticas de design, organização de código e manutenção de projetos de longo prazo.
  • Conhecimento sólido em modelagem de dados relacionais e otimização de queries SQL, especialmente em bancos como PostgreSQL ou MySQL.
  • Proficiência em ActiveRecord, ActionCable, ActionMailer e background jobs.
  • Experiência com performance tuning e estratégias para alta escalabilidade.
  • Práticas de testes automatizados (RSpec, Minitest, FactoryBot, etc.).


Infraestrutura e DevOps:

  • Experiência com Docker para containerização de aplicações.
  • Vivência em AWS com serviços como ECS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, ElasticSearch e Redis.
  • Conhecimento de CI/CD (preferencialmente GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou similares).


Monitoramento e Observabilidade:

  • Capacidade de configurar e interpretar métricas de APM e erros.
  • Experiência com ferramentas como New Relic, Datadog, Sentry ou similares.


Integrações e Comunicação entre Sistemas:

  • Experiência com serviços de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, Sidekiq ou similares).
  • Boas práticas em comunicação entre sistemas distribuídos (eventos assíncronos, retries, idempotência).
  • Experiência em background jobs, com foco em throughput, concorrência e resiliência.


Performance e Boas Práticas:

  • Experiência em otimização de aplicações web (tempo de resposta, uso de cache, indexação de banco).
  • Domínio em boas práticas de programação (Clean Code, SOLID, design patterns).
  • Conhecimentos de segurança de aplicações web (OWASP Top 10, autenticação, criptografia).


Desejável :

  • Experiência em integração com gateways de pagamento (ex: Stripe, Adyen, Pagar.me, Cielo, Stone, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de autenticação e segurança (OAuth2, JWT, TLS, assinatura de mensagens).
  • Vivência com conciliação de transações financeiras e tratamento de falhas em fluxos críticos (reprocessamento seguro, antifraude, consistência de dados).


Cuidados com a nossa gente:

Mantemos um ambiente descontraído, onde cada ideia conta. Na base da colaboração e criatividade, a gente está sempre evoluindo e de olho nas tendências que movem o mundo fitness


Aqui é tudo sobre o "porquê" fazemos o que fazemos. Apesar de sermos o maior Grupo de academias da América Latina, sabemos que a saúde e o bem-estar devem ser integral.

title: Sr. Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote


Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at


As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.


Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.


Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.


Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.


Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Objetivo do Cargo:

O Consultor de Ativação de Dados é responsável por transformar dados primários (1P data) em segmentos de audiência acionáveis que impulsionam campanhas de marketing personalizadas e orientadas por dados em múltiplos canais.

Essa função atua como líder funcional na criação e orquestração de audiências usando o Salesforce CDP e o Marketing Cloud , possibilitando ativações relevantes e oportunas sem necessidade de configuração técnica ou backend .

Com sólido conhecimento em modelos de dados, tabelas relacionais e lógica de segmentação , esse profissional faz a ponte entre as necessidades de negócio e as capacidades das plataformas — identificando os grupos de consumidores ideais com base em dados comportamentais, transacionais e declarados .

Ele assegura as melhores práticas de segmentação , garantindo preparo e precisão das campanhas e ativação eficaz em e-mail, mídia paga e outros pontos de contato endereçáveis.

Reportando-se ao líder de estratégia de CRM , esse cargo desempenha um papel fundamental na operacionalização da estratégia de dados primários (1P) — traduzindo objetivos estratégicos em definições precisas de audiência .

Trabalha em estreita colaboração com o Consultor de Ativação de Marketing , garantindo que a lógica das jornadas esteja alinhada ao design das audiências, e com as equipes técnicas globais de CDP , comunicando novas necessidades, validando viabilidades e solicitando atualizações no modelo de dados quando necessário.


Principais Responsabilidades:

1) Dados, Mensuração e Otimização

  • Criar e gerenciar segmentos de audiência no Salesforce CDP para ativações de CRM, Fidelidade e Mídia Paga, utilizando ferramentas nativas da plataforma e aplicando as melhores práticas do mercado.

  • Manter-se atualizado sobre novas funcionalidades da plataforma (ex.: audiências preditivas, modelos lookalike, scores de propensão) e propor melhorias de segmentação mais inteligentes .


2) Marketing Direto e Ativação de Audiências

  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos de dados 1P em planos de segmentação acionáveis , baseados em ciclo de vida, preferências, comportamentos e prioridades de negócio.

  • Monitorar a saúde do CDP e o desempenho das audiências , garantindo escalabilidade, eficiência e consistência nas ativações contínuas.

  • Assegurar que as regras de segmentação e definição de audiências estejam em conformidade com os padrões de governança de dados , políticas de privacidade e lógicas de opt-in/opt-out em todos os mercados e canais.
  • Manter documentação detalhada dos critérios de segmentação e dos processos de criação de audiência, garantindo transparência, rastreabilidade e transferência de conhecimento .

  • Atuar como especialista de referência em Salesforce CDP e nos fluxos de ativação de audiências , orientando equipes não técnicas sobre como solicitar e usar segmentos corretamente .
  • Colaborar com as equipes técnicas de CDP quando novas fontes de dados, atributos ou lógicas complexas exigirem suporte de backend, atuando como tradutor funcional das necessidades de negócio .
  • Identificar lacunas de dados ou problemas de usabilidade , propondo melhorias para aumentar a qualidade das segmentações e a eficiência operacional .


Experiência e Competências Necessárias:

  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, estratégia de CRM, operações de CDP ou campanhas orientadas por dados , preferencialmente em empresas de grande porte ou atuação multinacional.
  • Proficiência em SQL e lógica de segmentação .
  • Sólido entendimento de estruturas de dados primários (1P) , lógica de ciclo de vida do consumidor e princípios de marketing orientado por dados .
  • Perfil analítico , com habilidade para traduzir objetivos estratégicos de audiência em lógicas de segmentação executáveis .
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de marketing direto (ex.: Salesforce Marketing Cloud) e com o processo de ativação de segmentos via e-mail, push, fidelidade e mídia paga .
  • Conforto em trabalhar em ambientes multifuncionais , colaborando com equipes de estratégia, conteúdo, ativação e dados técnicos .

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
About Specialty Capital

Specialty Capital was founded just four years ago with a bold idea - to give “debanked” small businesses access to capital that’s Simple, Smart, and Reliable. Today, the company is among the top revenue-based finance companies in the U.S., serving thousands of merchants through a combination of speed, technology, and a deeply human approach. The company is profitable, founder-led, and growing rapidly with a culture built on grit, ownership, and mission.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Lead technology selection and evaluation processes for new tools, frameworks, and platforms

Mobile Application Architecture

  • Architect and oversee the development of native mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms
  • Design mobile solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences for loan applications and account management
  • Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services
  • Optimize mobile application performance and offline capabilities


Platform Development

  • Collaborate with SaaS vendors to ensure platform configurations align with architectural standards
  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes


Security & Compliance

  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies
  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures


Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical expertise in node.js, React, Swift, Java/Kotlin development
  • Review code, architectures, and technical designs to ensure quality and standards
  • Facilitate technical discussions and decision-making across teams
  • Establish development standards, coding practices, and documentation requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and technical practices

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; Master's degree preferred
  • 10-15 years of progressive experience in software architecture and development
  • Required: Extensive experience in mobile application development for iOS and Android platforms
  • Strong expertise in Swift for iOS and Java/Kotlin for Android development
  • Proven experience with financial technology platforms and payment systems
  • Deep knowledge of cloud architecture
  • Experience with node.js, React, mySQL, and modern web technologies
  • Strong background in API design, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, and reporting solutions
  • Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and financial services regulations
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in small business lending or commercial finance
  • Experience with Large Language Models / ML implementations in financial services
  • Knowledge of loan origination systems and credit decisioning platforms
  • Experience with React Native or cross-platform mobile development frameworks

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible working arrangements
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of a growing fintech company
  • Professional development opportunities and conference attendance
  • Collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and impact

Join Specialty Capital and play a pivotal role in revolutionizing small business lending through innovative technology solutions. As our Technical Architect, you'll have the opportunity to design systems that directly impact thousands of businesses across the country, helping them access the capital they need to grow and thrive.

Specialty Capital is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

Habilidades e Qualificações:

  • Experiência comprovada em implementação, configuração e otimização de SAP PP/QM.
  • Sólido conhecimento em princípios e práticas de planejamento da produção.
  • Excelentes habilidades analíticas, de resolução de problemas e de comunicação.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma eficaz em equipes multifuncionais e de construir relacionamentos sólidos com colegas e usuários.
  • Certificações SAP PP/QM ou experiência equivalente (experiência prática em negócios é muito importante).
  • Forte compreensão do SAP ERP e integração com outros módulos (MM, WM, FICO).
  • Inglês técnico (falado e escrito).
  • Capacidade de atuar em múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.
  • Conhecimento sobre produção de bens de consumo.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em qualquer fuso horário da América Latina (México ou Brasil).
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA (desejável).
  • Ingles: avançado
  • Espanhol: intermediário/avançado


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.

Nossos Valores

  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

title: Arquiteto Devops
description:
E qual será a sua missão na Framework?

A sua missão será desenhar, evoluir e garantir a integridade técnica das arquiteturas em nuvem que sustentam nossos produtos digitais , aplicando práticas modernas de DevOps, automação, segurança e observabilidade em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .

Você será responsável por estruturar e documentar arquiteturas de referência , traduzindo requisitos técnicos e de negócio em diagramas claros e escaláveis , além de implementar pipelines, automações e padrões que garantam performance, segurança e governança dos ambientes.

Mais do que construir soluções, esperamos que você atue como referência técnica e disseminador da cultura DevOps , apoiando squads e stakeholders na tomada de decisão arquitetural e na evolução contínua dos ecossistemas em nuvem da Framework e de seus clientes.


O que é preciso para fazer parte do time?

  • Experiência sólida como Arquiteto DevOps ou Engenheiro Cloud com foco em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .
  • Domínio de CI/CD (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, Jenkins ou GitLab CI) .
  • Prática em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible, Cloud Deployment Manager ou similares) .
  • Vivência com monitoramento, observabilidade e logging (Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic).
  • Experiência em containerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, GKE).
  • Conhecimento em segurança de pipelines, políticas IAM e gestão de secrets .
  • Entendimento de arquiteturas distribuídas, escalabilidade e resiliência de sistemas .

Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com ambientes híbridos (GCP + on-premises ou multicloud) .
  • Dominar práticas de FinOps e otimização de custos em nuvem .
  • Já tiver atuado em consultorias ou empresas de tecnologia com alto volume transacional .
  • Possuir conhecimento adicional em Azure ou AWS , ou ferramentas de observabilidade avançada (Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace) .
  • Demonstrar pensamento sistêmico e visão estratégica , contribuindo com decisões de arquitetura e escalabilidade.
  • Certificações complementares em DevOps, SRE, Kubernetes ou Security.

title: Corporate Sponsorship Sales
description:
Vendas de Patrocínios / Estandes para nossos Congressos de Inteligência Artificial, Tecnologia e Negócios América Digital, realizados no Chile, México e Estados Unidos (

Profissionais da área comercial com mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas B2B de patrocínios / sponsorships / estandes para congressos e feiras. Podem estar baseados no México, Colômbia, Brasil, Argentina, Uruguai, Panamá ou Miami, Estados Unidos.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades e funções?

  • Conduzir o processo integral de vendas B2B de patrocínios / sponsorships / estandes para nossos congressos e feiras, estabelecendo conexões diretas com C-Levels (Country Managers, Diretores de Vendas, Marketing) das 2000 principais empresas tecnológicas globais e locais.
  • Superar metas de vendas, com foco em garantir patrocínios das principais empresas de tecnologia para nossos congressos e feiras.
  • Gerenciar e cultivar relações sólidas com clientes existentes, garantindo uma experiência contínua e satisfatória.
  • Implementar estratégias para assegurar a retenção e renovação de contas-chave na carteira, transformando clientes em contas estratégicas, ampliando negócios por meio de upselling e cross-selling.
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento nas contas atribuídas, antecipando e atendendo às necessidades em constante mudança dos clientes.
  • Desenvolver planos e estratégias para ampliar a participação e maximizar o valor de cada conta.
  • Explorar ativamente novas oportunidades de negócios, identificando clientes potenciais e setores estratégicos.


Requisitos

  • Capacidade comprovada de vender e negociar em inglês.
  • Perfil hunter, com habilidades de prospecção, busca ativa de oportunidades, proatividade, autonomia, resiliência, aprendizado rápido e forte orientação para resultados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, além de sólidas competências de negociação.
  • Disponibilidade e recursos para trabalhar em tempo integral no modelo home office.
  • Mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas B2B de intangíveis, patrocínios, sponsorships, estandes.
  • Experiência em negociação com executivos C-Levels, VPs e gerentes de marketing regionais de grandes empresas tecnológicas da região e globais.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de transformação digital, TICs, Big Data, software, IoT, e-commerce e marketing digital.
  • Nível intermediário-avançado em CRM, Microsoft Office e softwares de produtividade em vendas.


O que oferecemos? Razões para se juntar à nossa equipe

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Salário base competitivo + as melhores comissões do mercado.
  • Cultura de trabalho colaborativa, ambiente multicultural com profissionais de diferentes países.
  • Fazer parte de uma empresa em constante crescimento.
  • Colaborar e aprender junto a profissionais e especialistas renomados.
  • Estar na vanguarda dos processos de vendas B2B e negociação.


Sobre nós

Através dos nossos congressos no Chile, México e Estados Unidos ( somos o ponto de encontro entre fornecedores globais e locais de soluções tecnológicas em Inteligência Artificial, Cloud, Big Data, IoT, Indústria 4.0, Telecomunicações, Software, Fintech, Web3, e-commerce, Marketing Digital e CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, CMOs, CDOs, CISOs, CFOs, líderes de negócios, inovação e transformação digital de operadoras, bancos, varejo, indústrias (manufatura, energia, petróleo e gás, mineração, agroindústria, utilities) e autoridades governamentais, ajudando-os a acelerar sua transformação digital e a migrar a economia dos países para uma economia digital.

Através do America Digital News TV ( somos o principal canal de TV e mídia online focado em notícias nas áreas de Inteligência Artificial, Inovação, Tecnologia, Negócios e Transformação Digital, alcançando atualmente mais de 145.000 assinantes.


Nossa missão

Através dos nossos congressos e meio online, ser o maior ecossistema de networking, capacitação e informação nas áreas de IA, Tecnologia, Transformação Digital e Negócios.


No momento da candidatura, responder às seguintes perguntas e enviar para:

  • Você possui um espaço de home office? (Espaço privado onde possa fechar a porta, trabalhar sem interrupções, horário integral, boa conexão à internet).

Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.
